{tārārahasyavṛttikā}
[prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
urjitānandagahanāṃ sarva(-)deva(-)svarūpiṇīm | parāṃ vāgrūpiṇīṃ vande mahānīlasarasvatīm || svaprakāśa(-)vimarṣākhya(-)bījādyaṅkurarūpiṇīm | pūrṇānandamayīṃ vande mahānīlasarasvatīm || nīlatantraṃ samājñāya siddhasārasvataṃ param | vīratantraṃ matsyasūktaṃ gāndharvaṃ pheravīntathā || gurūṇāñca mataṃ jñātvā gurubhiḥ śuddha(-)bhūmikā | [kṛtā śrīśaṅkareṇaiṣā tārārahasyavṛttikā] || nityapūjā(-)pramāṇantu prathame paṭale tathā | dīkṣā(-)vidhirdvitīye syāt puraścaryā tṛtīyake || naimittikaṃ caturthe syāt pañcame kāmya(-)nirṇayaḥ | rahasya(-)niyamaḥ ṣaṣṭhe kumārī saptame tathā || aṣṭame tu puraścaryā(-)rahasyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | navame paṭale devyā mantrāṇāṃ parinirṇayaḥ ||
daśame paṭale stotraṃ phalamekādaśe tataḥ | dvādaśe paṭale samyagbhāvānāṃ parinirṇayaḥ || nityapūjā(-)prayogastu paṭale ca trayodaśe | samyag vidhānaṃ homasya tārāyāśca caturdaśe || pañcadaśe tu mantrāṇāṃ vāsanā(-)yoganirṇayaḥ | iti tārārahasye tu samyak paṭalanirṇayaḥ ||
nanu vaiṣṇavādi(-)mataṃ vihāya kathaṃ śaktiviṣaye yatnaḥ kriyate(?) taireva bhukti(-)muktī bhavataḥ | kimaneneti (?) tathā ca śrutiḥ (īśopaniṣat ) ||
yo'vidyāmupāsate so'ndhantamaḥ praviśati || iti |
maivaṃ vaktavyam | saṃsāra(-)niyatirūpā stvavidyeti sureśvarācāryaḥ | tathāca śāmbhava(-)sūtre (-)
mamedaṃ khalu kartavyamakartavyamidaṃ mama | itthaṃ niyamanasyāsya heturniyati rucyate || tena tucchā'vidyā(-)pareyaṃ śrutiḥ | anuṣṭup śrutirapi (-)
jīvāśrayā brahma(-)padā hyavidyā tatvavinmatā | iti | jīvāśrayeti | jīvānāṃ mokṣa(-)daśāyāṃ brahmapadā brahmasvarūpā iti yāvat | prāmāṇika(-)vacanamapi (-) yatrāsti bhogo na ca tatra mokṣo yatrāsti mokṣo na ca tatra bhogaḥ | śivā(-)padāmbhoja yugārcakānāṃ bhogaśca mokṣaśca karastha eva || eva manyebhyo darśanebhyo bhoga(-)mokau ekatraiva na staḥ(,) cirakālābhyāsena kadācidapi sālokyādirūpo bhavati na veti | tathā ca ūrddhvāmnāye (-) yo'nyebhyodarśanebhyaśca bhuktiṃ muktiñca kāṅkṣati | svapnalabdha(-)dhanenaiva dhanavān sa bhaved yadi ||
śuktī rajata(-)vibhrāntiryathā jāyeta pārvati | tathānya darśanebhyaśca bhuktiṃ muktiñca kāṅkṣti || rudrajāmale'pi (-) vāma(-)dakṣiṇa siddhānta soma(-)pāśupatādiṣu | sālokyādyaṃ bhavettatra sāyujyaṃ matkulāgame || kulaṃ mātṛ(-)māna(-)meyam tasmācchaktyupāsakānāṃ sāyujyamuktireva | nanvevaṃ jñātaṃ(,) niḥsandigdho'smi | tathāpi pṛcche(,) (-) śaktyā paramparayā muktiḥ kiṃ vā sākṣāt somapānādivat (?) taduktaṃ durvāsasā bhagavatā divyamahimnastutau (-) saccittattvamasāti vākyaviditairbrahmātmavidyāśivaiḥ ātmādyai ratula(-)prabhāva(-)sahitaistattvaistribhiḥ sadguroḥ | tvadrūpasya mukhāravinda(-)vivarāt saṃprāpya dīkṣāmato yastvāṃ vindati tattvatastadaha mityārye sa mukto bhavet || apica siddhāntarbahubhiḥ purāṇagaditai ranyairavidyātamo nakṣatrairiva sarvamandhatamasaṃ tāvanna nirbhidyate | yāvatte saviteva sammatamidaṃ nodeti viśvāntare jantorjanmanivāraṇaika(-)bhiduraṃ śrīśāmbhavi śrīśive || evaṃ śuddha(-)sādhana(-)śīlānāṃ kulajñānāṃ mukhādvidyāprāptimātreṇa jīvanmuktā bhavantīti | tathā corddhvāmnāye (-) dhanairmāheśvarairdivyaḥ pratyabhijñānaśantibhiḥ | sva(-)parijñānamātreṇa jīvanmuktā bhavanti hi ||
etāsāṃ vidyānāṃ svakulādi vicāro nāstīti keṣāñcinmataṃ siddhamantratvāt | tatra | māyātantre (-) nāśrayedarimantrantu mitramantraṃ samāśrayet | ityādi vacanādvicāro yukta eva | yathā kālī tathā nīleti vacanādarimitrādidūṣaṇaṃ nātra mantavyamiti | tathāpi viśeṣo yathā vārāhītantre (-) nakṣatra(-)śuddhistāriṇyā nānyaccakraṃ vicārayet iti prādhānyenoktamajñātaviṣaye | idānīṃ prātaḥkṛtyamāha | brāhma muhūrte utthāya oṃ kulavṛkṣebhyo nama iti kula(-)vṛkṣaṃ namaskṛtya guruṃ dhyāyet | taduktaṃ rudrajāmale (-) prātarutthāya mantrajñaḥ kulavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya ca | śiraḥ padme guruṃ dhyātvā yajettannamapūrvakam || kulacūḍāmaṇī ca (-) sādhusiddha tarucchrāyaṃ kulavṛkṣaṃ praṇasya ca | mūlādi brahmarandhrāntaṃ kulaṃ dhyātvā guruṃ smaret || tataḥ śiraḥ paṅkaje paramaśivarūpaṃ gurumabhipūjya dyāyet | tadāha (-) sahasra(-)dala paṅkaje sakala śītaraśmiprabhaṃ varābhayakarāmbujaṃ vimalagandhapuṣpāmbaram | prasannavadanekṣaṇaṃ sakaladevatārūpiṇaṃ smarecchirasi haṃsagaṃ tadabhidhānapūrvaṃ gurum || haṃsagaṃ sarvottirṇa(-)pīṭhastham | tato mānasairupacārairārādhya namaskuryāt | tathā coktaṃ viśvamate (-) kaniṣṭhā pṛthivītattvaṃ tadyogādgandhayojanam | aṅguṣṭhā gaganaṃ tattvaṃ tenaiva puṣpayojanam || tarjanī vāyutattvaṃ syādrūpaṃ tenaiva yojayet | tejastattvaṃ madhyamā syāt dīpaṃ tenaiva yojayet || anāmā jalatattvaṃ syāt tenaiva yojayeccarum ||
laṃ pṛthivyātmakaṃ gandhaṃ samarpayāmi ityādikrameṇa sampūjyāṣṭottaraśataṃ vāgbhavaṃ (aiṃ) japitvā japaṃ samarpya namaskuryāt | taduktaṃ bhairavatantre (-) tato mānasa gandhādyai rarcayet svasvamudrayā | tatastu vāgbhavaṃ japyādaṣṭottaraśataṃ sudhīḥ || japaṃ samarpya bhaktyā ca praṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi | praṇāma mantrastu (-) akhaṇḍa maṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || tato mūlādhārapadme trikoṇāntargatādhomukha svayambhuliṅgaveṣṭanīṃ taḍitkoṭikaḍārāṃ mūlavidyāmayīṃ kulakuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā suṣumnāvartmanā paramaśive saṅgamayya tadamṛtadhārayā lolībhūtāṃ caitanyamayīṃ punarmūlādhāramānayet | tathāca prāmāṇikavacanam (-) prakāśamānāṃ prathame prayāṇe pratiprayāṇepyamṛtāyamānām | antaḥpadavyāmanusañcarantī mānandarupā mavalāṃ prapadye || tata utthāyāvaśyakaṃ karma kuryāt | taduktaṃ matsyasūkte (-) utthāya cottare yāme kuṇḍalīṃ taḍidākṛtim | dhyātvā siddhīśvarī bhūtvā muktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ || nīlatantre'pi | utthāya cottare yāme cintayedugratāriṇīm | mūlādi brahmārandhrāntaṃ visatantu svarūpiṇīm || mūlamantramayīṃ sākṣādamṛtānandarūpiṇīm | sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām |
taḍitkoṭisamaprakhyāṃ kāmānalaśikhopari | tatprabhāpaṭalavyāptapāṭalīkṛta(-)dehavān || iti prātaḥkṛtyam | tataśca vahirgatvāvaśyakaṃ vidhāya sarvamaṅgalasampannaḥ snānakarma samācaret | mṛkuśānapi saṃgṛhya gatvā jalāntikaṃ tataḥ || malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snātvā mantrasnānaṃ samācaret | vīratantre (-) vidyayā trirnimajjyaiva mācāmet pāthasā tathā | mūlānte tarpayāmīti svāhāntaṃ tarpaṇaṃ matam || evaṃvidham snāna(-)karma kṛtvā pāpakṣayo bhavet | tataḥ snānakāle saṃprāpte yathāvidhi snātvā sandhyā tarpaṇe kṛtvā devarṣi pitṛ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mūlavidyānte śrīnīlasarasvatīmugratārāmekajaṭāṃ vā tarpayāmi svāheti tristarpayet | taduktaṃ nīlatantre (-) punarnimajjya payasi saṅkalpañca samācaret | iṣṭadevyāḥ pūjanārthaṃ kuryāt snānaṃ jalāśaye || kuśīda(-)moḍra puṣpañca kulapuṣpaṃ kulodakam | prasthagrāhi tāmrapātre kṛtvā cārghyaṃ nivedayet || mūlānte codyadādityamaṇḍalamadhyavartinyai | śivacaitanyamayyai ca svāheti tanmanuḥ smṛtaḥ || sūryāyārghyaṃ pradāyaiva pūjā(-)sthānaṃ samāviśet | iti vacanāddevyarghyadānānantaraṃ sūryārghya dānamāyāti(,) kintu tantrāntaraikavākyatvāt devyarghya dānāt pūrvaṃ sūryārghyaṃ dānamiti saṃpradāyaḥ | nīlatantroktaṃ snānamidaṃ
nīlasarasvatīpakṣe(,) athavā gāyatrādyanuṣṭhānayuktaṃ (kto) māyātantrokta ekajaṭādividyāyāḥ snāna vidhirlikhyate | brāhme muhūrte utthāya śiraḥ padme guruṃ smaran | mūlādi brahmarandhrāntaṃ mūlavidyāṃ vibhāvayet || udyatsūrya pratīkāśāṃ kuṇḍalīṃ paradevatām | yātāyātakrameṇaiva amṛtīkṛtavigrahām || mūlavidyāṃ japed dhyātvā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ kramāt | mṛtkuśānapi saṃgṛhya gatvā nadyantike sudhīḥ || mṛttikāṃ mūlamantreṇa saṃgṛhya ca karadvaye | sūryāya darśayettacca paścādvilepanaṃ smṛtam || go(-)karīṣaṃ nāsikāyāṃ va mantreṇa puṭadvaye | jalāñjalitrayaṃ dadyān mūddhni hṛnnābhikeṣu ca || tata ācamanaṃ kuryāt trikoṇaṃ dakṣiṇena tu | gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā devi śaṅkhāvartakrameṇa tu || vilokya tatra nirmajje daghamarṣaṇakaṃ tridhā | kūrcabījena dakṣiṇahaste trikoṇaṃ kṛtvā tatra jalamādāya(,) tatra kūrcabījaṃ tridhā japtvā tajjalaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ miḍayākṛṣyāntargata malaṃ prakṣālya kajjalābhaṃ tajjalaṃ dakṣiṇa nāsāpuṭena niḥsārya(,) dakṣiṇe vajrapāṣāṇe kṣipet | etadevāghamarṣaṇam | dadyā jjalāñjalīn trīṇi varuṇāya tataḥ param | somāya bhānave paścājjalādutthāya vāsasī || paridhāya tato mantrī yathāvidhi samācaret | tilakaṃ raktagandhena gopīcandanakena tu ||
devyastraṃ vilikhedbhāle tārābījaṃ tato hṛdi | śaktiṃ madhyagatāṃ kuryāt prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret || ācamya prāṅmukho bhūtvā upaviśya ca mantravit | prasaṅgāt śāktācamanaṃ likhyate (-) taduktaṃ mālinītantre (-) ācāmedātmatattvādyaiḥ praṇavādyairdviṭhāntakaiḥ | mantraistridhā tathā vaktraṃ nāsā'kṣi(-)śrotranābhi hṛt mastakāṃsān spṛśenmantī kuryāt śrotrābhivandanam | ātma vidyā śivāstattvaṃ praṇavaṃ vāgbhavaṃ matam || aghamarṣaṇakaṃ tatra kūrcabījajapo mataḥ | ācamanepi kūrcabījaṃ yojyaṃ tārāpraṇavatvāt | trikoṇaṃ mūlabījena savitre haṃsakaṃ japan | upasthāpya japeddevīṃ gāyatrīṃ śṛṇu sundari | tārāyai vidmahe proktā mahogrāyai ca dhīmahi | tanno devīti śabdānte dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt || gāyatryeṣā samākhyātā sarvapāpanikṛntanī | vāmapādaṃ tataḥ kuryāddakṣapāde sureśvari | upasthāya punarhaṃsamūrddhavāhustridhā japet || tatra haṃsa ṛgyathā (-) oṃ haṃsaḥ śuci ṣadvasurantarikṣasadghotā vedisadatithirdūronasat | nṛṣaharasadṛtasadvyomasadañjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ vṛhat iti |
tīrthodakaṃ tila kalkaṃ kṣīrākṣatasamanvitam | uttarāśāmukho bhūtvā devīmātraṃ pratarpayet || mulānte tāriṇīṃ proktvā tarpayāmyagnivallabhā | svarṇapātreṇa raupyeṇa tāmrapātreṇa vā punaḥ || ṛjukuśatrayeṇaiva santarpya bhaktitaḥ sudhīḥ | dakṣiṇāśā mukhī bhūtvā saṃgṛhya moṭakaṃ tataḥ || trapyantu pitaraḥ proktvā etattarpaṇamādiśet | sūryasya vandanañcaiva mabhedena tayorapi | gāyatrīṃ prajapeddhīmānaghamarṣaṇameva ca || etat sandhātraye caiva arddharātrī ca vandanam | mahārātrāvapi tathā kāryā deśikasattamaiḥ || iti | tatraiva (-) arddha rātrāt paraṃ yacca muhūrtadvayameva ca | sā mahārātri ruddiṣṭā tatra kṛtvā'kṣayaṃ bhavet || tato vidyāṃ hṛdi dhyātvā aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | avahirmānaso yogī yāgabhūmi mathāviśet || yāgasthānamāha phetkārīye ekaliṅge śmaśāne vā śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe | tatrasthaḥ sādhayedyogī vidyāṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm || ekaliṅga lakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva (-) pañcakrośāntare yatra na liṅgāntaramīkṣyate | tadeka liṅgamākhyātaṃ tatra siddhiranuttamā || catuṣpatha lakṣaṇaṃ yathā tantrāntare (-) catuṣpathaṃ vijānīyād yatrāste tāriṇī śilā | tatra yatnena gantavyaṃ japtavyaṃ siddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
anyatrāpi (-) urrjaṭe parvate vāpi nirjane vā catuṣpathe | devāgāre ca śūnye ca nirjanekānta veśmani || vīratantre'pi (-) śūnyāgāre śmaśāne yadi japati jaḍastvekaliṅge taḍāge gaṅgāgarbhe girau vā śuci ramalamatiḥ sarvadā bhaktiyuktaḥ | vidyāṃ śrīnīlavāṇyā bhuvanajanapatiḥ sarvaśāstrārthavettā dehānte yogi mukhyaḥ paramasukhapadaṃ brahma (-) nirvāṇameti || etadanyatamaṃ sthānamāsthāya tatra pīṭhaṃ cintayet | taduktaṃ gāndharvākhye (-) śmaśāne tatra sañcintya tatra kalpadrumaṃ smaret | tanmūle maṇipīṭhañca nānāmaṇi vibhūṣitam | nānālaṅkāra bhūṣāḍhyaṃ munidevaiśca maṇḍitam | śivābhirvahumāṃsāsthimodamānābhirantataḥ || caturdikṣu śavān muṇḍāṃścitāṅgārāsthi bhūṣitān | tanmadhye bhāvayeddevīṃ yathoktadhyāna yogataḥ | iti pīṭhaṃ sañcintya jalādiśodhanaṃ kuryāt | oṃ vajrodake hūṃ phaṭ
svāhā iti jalamadhiṣthāya oṃ viśuddhadharmagātri (!) sarvapāpāni śamayāśeṣavikalpamapanaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ityanena pādau prakṣālya oṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā ityācamya oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi (!) sarvavaśaṅkari (!) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti śikhāvandhanam | oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti jalābhiṣekād bhūmiśodhanam | oṃ sarvavighānutsāraya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti nārāca mudrayā'kṣataprakṣepāttrividhavighnānutsārayet | oṃ pavitra yajñabhūme (!) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti bhūmimāmantrā(,) tatra mṛdu kambala komala viṣṭarādyāsana māstīrya āḥ surekhe vajrarekhe hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti raktacandanapuṣpābhyāṃ tadabhyarcya svastikādikrameṇa tatropaviśet | taduktaṃ matsyasūkte (-)
mṛdu komalamāsīno'pyanyeṣu kambaleṣu vā | viṣṭare vā samāsīnaḥ sādhayet siddhimuttamām || saṃgrāmapatitaṃ vāpi vyāpāditamacūḍakam | vaṇmāsaniḥsṛtaṃ prāpya citāyāṃ vā tadantike || asyāyamarthaḥ | daśamāsādarvāk ṣaṇmāsāt paraṃ garbhacyuto bālako mṛduḥ | acuḍako'kṛtacūḍākaraṇaḥ | jananāt pañcavarṣābhyantare'cūḍaka iti kecit | upanayanasamayā darvāk cūḍākaraṇāt paraṃ komalābhidhānam | eṣāmabhāve viṣṭareṣu kuśeṣu vā | taduktaṃ śrīkrame (-) vīrāsanamabhāve tu mṛtāsanaṃ śṛṇu priye | pañcavarṣābhyantaraṃ yāvanmṛtaṃ vālamacūḍakam || ṣaṇmāsānantaraṃ yāvaddaśamāsācca pūrvakam | garbhacyutaṃ mṛtaṃ bālaṃ garbhāṣṭamapuraḥsaram || etat komalamityāhurviṣṭareṣu kuśeṣu vā | taduktaṃ matsyasūkte (-)
kṛṣṇasāradvīpicarma acūḍaṃ kambalaṃ tathā | pītañca śvetaraktaṃ vā āsanāya prakalpayet || protaṃ vā vistṛtaṃ vāpi athavā kuṇḍalīkṛtam iti | kuśaviṣṭarasyāyamarthaḥ | kuśapatraśatena vaṭukaṃ nirmāya(,) śavapraṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | (tatra śavabuddhyā upaviśet) komalāderabhāve taccarmamātraṃ āhyamityārādhyapādāḥ | eteṣāmāsanānāṃ yathāprāptābhidhānaṃ caturasraṃ hastapramāṇam tatra candanādinā madhye maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā śavabījaṃ likhet | evamāsanarahasyamārādhyapādamukhādavagantavyam | tataśca oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti vastrāntike rakṣāgranthiṃ vadhnīyāt | oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā kāyavāk cittaśodhanam | oṃ namaḥ puṣpaketu rājārhati śatāya samyak sambandhāya oṃ puṣpe puṣpe mahāpuṣpe supuṣpe puṣpasambhave puṣpacayāvakīrṇa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti puṣpābhimantraṇam | taduktaṃ tantrāntare (-) tāro maṇidharītyante vajriṇītipadaṃ likhet | mahāprasare rakṣayugmaṃ hūṃ phaṭ tathaiva ca || svāheti vastraprānteṣu rakṣāgranthiṃ samācaret | tāro'nantaḥ sarga yukto hūṃ phaṭ svāheti mantrataḥ ||

saṃsāra duḥkha rahitaṃ nirmalaṃ devatā'bhedena cintayet | tasmin viśvavyāpakavāriṇi āḥkārādraktapaṅkajaṃ dhyātvā tadupari ṭāṅkārāt śvetapaṅkajaṃ vicintayet | tadupari nīla sannibhaṃ hūṅkāraṃ dhyātvā hūṅkāra bījabhūṣitāṃ kartṛkāṃ dhyāyet | kartryupari gatāmātmābhedena devatāṃ dhyāyet | āṃ hrīṃ krīṃ svāhā taduktaṃ phetkārīye (-) māyāṃ nābhau raktavarṇāṃ dhyātvā tajjāta vahninā | śuṣkaṃ karmātmakaṃ dehaṃ dagdhaṃ sañcintayettataḥ || strīṅkāraṃ hṛdi pītābhaṃ taduddhṛtena vāyunā | bhasma protsāritaṃ kṛtvā lalāṭe cintayettataḥ || kūrcaṃ tuṣāravarṇābhaṃ tadudbhūtāmṛtena tu | tadasthiplāvitaṃ kṛtvā tadātmānaṃ vicintayet || sarvavyathā vinirmuktaṃ nirmalaṃ devatātmakam | viśvavyāpakatoye tu śvetāñjīdbhavakarṇikām || tadupari nīlasannibhaṃ hūṅkāraṃ dhyātvā hūṅkārabījabhūṣitāṃ kartrikāṃ dhyāyet |

akṣobhyodevīmūrddhanya strimūrtirnāgarūpadhṛk || (ataeva mūrddhni gururdhyeyaḥ | aho paradevatāyā vedamayyā vedābhyupagantṛtā yataḥ śiṣyaśikṣārthaṃ svayamapi mūrddhni gururdhṛtaḥ | tathāca bhagavadvākyaṃ ācāryaḥ śirasisthita iti | atha dhyānānantaraṃ śrīśaṅkarācāryabhagavatpādai stotrarūpeṇoktam jvalat pāvaketyādinā sarvārthasiddhai dhyāyet | tadyathā (-) jvalat(-)pāvaka(-)jvālajālātibhāsvat citāmadhyasaṃsthāṃ supuṣṭāṃ mukharvām | śavaṃ vāmapādena kaṇṭhe nipīḍya sthitāṃ dakṣiṇenāṅghriṇāṅghrī nipīḍya || 1 || vṛhattuṅgalambodarīṃ meghavarṇām samuttuṅgapīnastanābhogaramyām | javārāgarajyatsuvṛttatriṇetrām lalajjihvayā daṃṣṭrayā bhīṣaṇāsyām || 2 ||

iti śrutayaḥ | evambhutamātmānaṃ dhyāyediti bhūtaśuddhiḥ | atha mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāma kuryāta | tata ṛṣyādi nyāsaḥ | śirasi akṣobhya ṛaṣaye namaḥ | mukhe vṛhatī chandase namaḥ | hṛdi śrīmadekajaṭāyai devatāyai namaḥ | druta kavitva pānḍatya siddhaye viniyogaḥ | tadruktaṇ nīlatantre | akṣobhya ṛṣiretasyā vṛhato chanda īritam | nīlā sarasvatī devī triṣu lokeṣu gopitā || huṃ bījama straṃ śaktiḥ syāccatuvargaphalapradā || tathā eka vīrākalpe (-) aṅgnayāsa karanyāsau kuyyādattraiva kevalam | atroktamācaredatra nānyata sañcārayeta sudhīḥ || iti vacanāta nyāsāntarābhāvaḥ | mātṛkāyā āvaśyakatvāta kālītantrokta mātṛkānyāso'tra likhitah | taduktaṃ nīlatantre yathā kālī tathā nīlātatakramānmātṛkāṃ nyaseta || tada yathā(-) a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ iti hṛdayaṃ spṛśeta | e ai a au aṃ aḥ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ khaṃ dakṣiṇa bhuje | uṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ eṃ ṭaṃ ṭaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ vāmabhuje | ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ vaṃ bhaṃ dakṣiṇa jṅghāyām | maṃ vaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ vāma jaṅghāyām | atha karāṅganyāsau yathā (-) hāṃ akhilabāgarūpinyai namaḥ | aṅgaṣṭayoḥ | hrīṃ akhaṇḍa vāprūpinyai svāhā tarjanyoḥ | hraṃ brahmāvāgrūpinyai vaṣaṭ madhyamayoḥ | hrai(/) viṣṇuvāgarupinyai hu(/) anāmikayoḥ | hroṃ rudra vāgrāpinyai vauṣaṭha kaniṣṭhayoḥ | hraḥ sarva vāgrūpinyai phaṭa karatala pṛṣṭayoḥ || tato'khilavāgrūpinyādikamuktvā | tarjanī madhyamā nāmikābhirhṛdayāy namaḥ tarjanī madhyamābhyāṃ śirase svāhā | adho'ṅguṣṭamuṣṭhyā śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | vyāsta'stāṅgulobhiḥ kavacāya hu(/) | tarjanī madhyamānāmikābhirnetratrayay vauṣat | tarjanī madhyamābhyāṃ astrāya phaḍiti ūrddhārddhatālatrayachoṭikābhirdaśadigbandhanaṃ kuryāt | (evaṃ binduvisarga nirbindu nirvisarga

vidyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍadhā ca mātṛkāṃ nyaset | kramotakramād varārohe tārāṣoḍhā prakīrtitā || ye stvavaṃ kurūte mantrī satu tārā na saṃśayaḥ || tasya loke gururnāsti saguruḥ sarvayoginām | sṛṣṭhirakārādikṣakārāntā | sthitisttu ḍādiṭhāntā | saṃhṛtisttukṣakārādya kārāntā | ayaṃ nyāsasttu kāmyaḥ viśeṣākāṅkhibhirācaranīyaḥ || taduktaṃ siddhasārasvate (-) akhilavāgrupinī procya hṛdayāya namo vadet | akhanḍavāgrūpinītyuktvā śirase vahvivallabhā | brahmavāgrūpinītyuktvā śikhāyai vaṣaḍityāpi || viṣṇubāgrūpiṇītuktvā kavacāya hu(/)muccaret | rūdrabāga rūpiṇītuktvā netratrayāya vauṣaḍityāpi || sarvavāgaruṣiṇītyuktvā'strāya phaḍiti smaret | etacca nīlasarasvatī pakṣe | mantracūḍāmaṇautu (-) bījānte eka jaṭāyai hṛdayaṃ parakīrtitam | tārinyai śirase tadvadvajjrādake śikhā tathā || ugrajaṭe ca kavacaṃ mahāpratisare tathā | piṅgograikajaṭe tadvannetrānte parikīrtitam ||
ubhābhyāṃ mahogratārāpakṣe | pīṭhanyāsya varṇanyāsyau (bāhunyāta) na likhitau | (atrānupraveśo nāsti) taduktaṃ eka vīrākalpe (-) aṅganyāsa karanyāsau kuryādatraiva kevalam | atroktamācaredatra nānyata saccārayeta sudhīḥ || tato mūlamuccaryaṃ śira ādi pādāntaṃ pādādi śiro'ntaṃ hṛdayādimukhāntaṃ iti vyāpakatrayaṃ nyaset | (tato'rghyapātra sthāpanamiti kecit|) tataḥ pūrvoktaṃ dhyātvā kara kalitadūrvākṣata vajrapuṣpādi milite dinakara kiraṇāruṇa kusumācñalau mātṛkāyantraṃ dhyātvā hṛdayāta mūlamantra tejomayīṃ śuddhajñāna caitanya rūpāṃ tāṃ ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa śivo'vasthita sahasradalakamalāntargataṃ paramaśivaṃ prāpayitvā kriyāsamabhihāreṇa tadamṛtāmbudhau viśrāmya tadamṛtalolībhūtāṃ ānandamayīṃ tejomayīṃ tāṃ pravaddannāsāpuṭena ānīya kalpitamūrtī samāvahayet | deveśi bhaktisulabhe parivāra samanvite | yāvattvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi tāvattvaṃ susthirā bhava | śrīmadekajaṭe ihāgacha ihāgacha ityāvāhya āvāhana saṃsthāpana sannidhāpana sannibodhādīn tattanmudrābhiḥ kuryāt | tato devyaṅge ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ svāheti prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya mūlavidyānte śrīmadekajaṭe vajrapuṣpaṃ pratīccha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | ityanena pādyādibhiḥ ṣoḍaśopacārairarcayet | taduktaṃ phetkāriṇyāṃ (-)
āvahya sthāpayitvā tu dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayet tataḥ | śrīmadekajaṭe caiṣa vajrapuṣpaṃ pratīccha ityapi || mūlenāgnipriyāntena satāreṇa yajet punaḥ | upacāra manuproktaḥ sarvāgama viśāradaiḥ || nīlatantre'pi (-) sarvaṃ mantramayaṃ kṛtvā devatāyai nivedayet | abhāvādvajrapuṣpasya smaraṇāt phalabhāg bhavet || ṣoḍaśopacāraniyamo yathā | taduktaṃ mantranīlāvatyāṃ (-) pādyārghyacāmana snāna vasanābharaṇāni ca | gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpa naivedyācamanantathā || tāmbulamarcanā stotraṃ tarpanañca namaskriyā | prayojayaidarcanāyāṃ upacārāṃsttu ṣoḍaśa || athavā(-)gandhādayo naivedyāntā pūjā pañcopacārikā | atra puṣpa niyamo yathā | taduktaṃ matasyamukte (-) puṣpa śreṣṭhaṃ raktakokaṃ bandhukaṃ śatapatrakam | barbarādvitayañcaiva karṇikāradvayaṃ tathā || vakamandāravajrāṇi karavīrāṇi śasya te || mallikātritayaṃ jāti kṣauma puṣpaṃ jayantikā || bilvapuṣpaṃ kuravakyuti puṣpaka keśaram | vāsantodvitayañcaiva kāśapuṣpaṃ maruvakam || (kadamba vakulañcaiva lavaṅgakusumaṃ tathā ||) yūtho śephālikācyūta pu.pairarcayet kulaiḥ || bilvaimerūvakādaiśca tulasī varjitaiḥ śubhaiḥ | aḍrapūṣpairviśeṣeṇa vajrapuṣpena miśritam || sarva puṣpaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā | iti ||
tathā mantracūḍāmaṇī arghaṃ dadyājjavāyuktaṃ dāpayenmantramuccaraṇ | vajrapuṣpaṃ pratīccheti sambodhana padānvitam || naivedyañca yathā matasyasūkte (-) vāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ dadyāccharkarāguḍasaṃyutam | gavyaṃ dadhi madhūnmiśraṃ pāṇīyañca nivedayet || śālamatasañca pāṭīnaṃ godhikāmāṃ samuttamam || annañca madhunā yuktaṃ yatnāddadyācca mantravit || tato yonimudrāṃ pradarśya ājñāṃ pārthya parivāramarcayet | yathā keśareṣu agnīśāsura vāyuṣu madhye dikṣuca devyāstadaṅgevāṣaḍaṅgamarcayet | pūrvādidikniyamastu (-) pūjya pūjakayormadhyaṃ prācīti kīrtyate budhaiḥ | taddakṣiṇaṃ dakṣinaṃsyāduttarañcottaraṃ matam || pṛṣṭhantu paścimaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvatraivaṃ prapujayet || iti mānasollase | hrā akhilavāgrūpinyai hṛdayāya nama eka jaṭāyai hṛdayāya nama ityādi krameṇa vā | tadruktamekavīrā kalpe (-) ṣaḍaṅgamarcayeddevyā dehevā keśareṣu vā | asminneva samaye devyā vāyavyādīśānāntaṃ gurūpaṃktiṃ arcayet | tadaśaktau gurutrayaṃ vā ṛṣimātraṃ vā | taduktaṃ bhāvacūmaṇī (-) īśvara uvāca mātardevi mahāmāye bandhamokṣa pravartini | idānīṃ śrotumicchami gurūkramamanuttamam || devyuvāca (-) gurūkramastu bahudhā mantravistara gauravāt | kālānāmapyanāditvāt kathaṃ tat kathayāmite || gurukramaṃ na ca jñātvā naṣṭhamārgu bhaviṣyati | naṣṭhamārga mantravidyau na tādṛk siddhigo bhavet ||
gurūṇāṃ siddhibhūtānāṃ nāsticet santatikramaḥ | tantravidyāśca mantrāśca niṣphalā nātra saṃśayaḥ || unviṃśati purūṣān vāpi nava saptatrayo'pivā | na jñātvā guruvaṃśānāṃ śiṣyaśca naṣṭha santatiḥ || svavaṃśādadhikaṃ jñeyaṃ gurūvaṃśa śubhāśubham | janakādadhiko jñeyo mantradaśca maheśvaraḥ || tasmād yatnena deveśa saṃkṣepāt śṛṇu tān gurūn || atha tārāgurūn vakṣye duṣṭāduṣṭa phala pradān || urddhakeśo vyomakeśo nīlakanṭho vṛṣadhvajaḥ | divyaughā siddhidā vatsa siddhaughān śṛṇu tattvataḥ | vaśiṣṭhaḥ kūrmanāthaśca mīnanātho maheśvaraḥ | harinātho mānavaughān śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sadgurūn || tārāvatī bhānumatī jayā vidyā mahodarī | sukhānandaḥ parānandaḥ pārijātaḥ kuleśvaraḥ || virupākṣa pheravīca kathitaṃ tārinīkulam | siddhaughā mānabaudhāsttu divyaughā parameśvara | akṣobhyaḥ sarvamūrddhaṇya strimūrttināgarupadhṛk | ānandanātha śabdāntā guravaḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ | striyo'pi gururūpāśca ambāntrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | athavā sarvaśāstreṣu guravaḥ pūrvasucitāḥ | kula cūḍāmaṇau (-) deva śṛṇu gurūn vakṣye guru devān maheśvara | yeṣu yeṣu ca mantreṣu ye ye ṛṣigaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||

japalakṣaṇaṃ vimalātantre yathā (-) manaḥ saṃharaṇaṃ śaucaṃ maunaṃ mantrārthacintanam | avyapratvamanirvedo japasampatti hetavaḥ || japaḥsyāt trividhāvṛtti maunasopāṃśuvācakaiḥ | mantramuccaravedvācā vācikaḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ || śanairuccārayenmatramīṣaddoṣṭhaṃ pracālayan | kiñcichravana yogyaṃ syādupāṃśuḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ || dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇīṃ varṇasvara padātmikām | uccaredatha saṃsmṛtya mānasaḥ sajapaḥ smṛtaḥ || upāṃśuḥ puṣṭikāmānāṃ mānasaḥ siddhimicchatām || vāciko māraṇe śasta strividhojapa īritaḥ | tatra japarahasyaṃ yathā | mūlādhāra svādhiṣṭhāna maṇi pūrakeṣu taḍitakoṭikaṭārāṃ bījavyāptiṃ vibhāvya tathaiva phaṭkāraṃ hṛdaye dhyeyam | (taduktaṃ nīlatantra) mantradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi japāt sarva pradāyikām | mantra dhyānānmaheśāni siddhyate brahmahā yataḥ | mūlacakre ca hṛllekhāṃ sūryakoṭi samaprabhām | svādhiṣṭhāne pītavarṇaṃ dvitīyārṇaṃ vibhāvayet || nābhau jīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ kūrcabījaṃ mahāprabham | astrabījaṃ hṛdi dyāyet kālānala samaprabham | mūlādi brahmarandhrāntaṃ sarvā vidyāṃ vibhāvayet || sūryakoṭi pratīkāśāṃ yogibhirdveṣṭhī pūrvikām || athavā sarvāṃ vidyāṃ dīparupiṇīṃ jihvāyāṃ vibhājya tata prabhāpaṭalairjihvāmapi dīparupiṇīṃ vibhājya japet |
taduktaṃ phetkārīye (-) jihvāyāṃ nyasanādeva mūko'pisukavirbhavet || iti | mukhe karaṃ datvā japedityārābhya pādāḥ || nityapūjā japa niyamastu (-) sahasraikaṃ japenmantraṃ śataṃ tat tritayantu vā | viṃśati vā japenmatraṃ ato nyūnaṃ na yujyate || tato guhyātiguhya goptrītvaṃ gṛhānasmakṛtaṃjapam | siddhirbhavatu me devi tvatprasādāddhadisthitā || iti mantreṇārghyodaka kusumairdevyā vāmādhohaste tejomayaṃ japaṃ samparpayet iti | viśeṣa phalākāṅkhibhirayaṃ kramo niśāyāmavamarṣaṇīyaḥ | taduktaṃ phetkārīye valipūjādikaṃ yadyad niśāyāṃ kriyate sadā | tattadakṣayatāṃ yāti tārādevyā prasādataḥ || tadruktaṃ māyātantre (-) arddharātrāt paraṃ yacca muhūrtadvayameva ca | sā mahārātri rudiṣṭā niśā sā parakīrtitā || kūlacūḍāmaṇau tu (-) rātrau paryaṭanañcaiva rātrau ca śakti pūjanam | na karoti kathaṃ deva sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet || kulaṃ mātṛmānameyaṃ mātā jīvo mānaṃ pramāṇaṃ jñānamiti yāvat | meyaṃ ghaṭapaṭādirūpaṃ viśvamiti yāvat | śākta iti saṅkalitārthaḥ | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya stutvāṣṭhāṅgapātena praṇamet | atha stutiḥ (-) ghorarūpe mahārāve sarva śatrukṣayaṅkari | bhaktebhyo varadedevi trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || surāsurārcite devi siddha gandharva sevite | jāḍyapāpahare devi trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || jaṭājuṭa samāyukte lola jihvānukāriṇī | druta buddhikare devi trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || saumyarūpe canḍarūpe ghorarūpe namo'stute | sṛṣṭirūpe namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||
jaḍānāṃ jaḍatāṃ haṃsi bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsale | mūḍhatāṃ harame trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || hū(/) hū(/) kāramaye devi bali homaṃ priye namaḥ | ugratāre namo nityaṃ trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || indrādi diviṣadvṛnda vandite karuṇāmayi | tāre tārādhināthāsye trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ | ṣanmāsaiḥ siddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt || vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ tarkavyākaraṇādikām | idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhed yastu satataṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || tasya śatru kṣayaṃ yāti mahāprajñā ca jāyate | pīḍāyāṃ vāpi saṃgrāme japye dāne tathā maye || ya idaṃ paṭhati stotraṃ śubhaṃ tasya na saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ stutvā daṇḍavat praṇamya yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet | ātmasamarpaṇañca kāryam | itaḥ pūrtvaṃ(?) prāṇa buddhideha dharmakārito jāgratasvapna suṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇaśiṅā yatakṛtaṃ yatasmṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ tata sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇa bhavatu svāhā | aṣṭāṅgapraṇatiryathā | taduktaṃ prapañcasāre (-) padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā śirasā dṛśā | vacasā manasā ceti praṇāmo'ṣṭhāṅga īritaḥ || viśeṣa namaskārastu saṅketatantre(-) natistu trikoṇākārā tārāyāḥ parikīrtitā | ardhācandraṃ maheśasya pṛṣṭhaśca samīhitā || vedavidbhyo dharāṃ datvā samyagyallabhate phalam | tata phalaṃ samavāpnoti sakṛta kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam || tata āvṛtti devatāṃ devyaṅge vilāṇya kṣamasveti suṣumnāvartmanā svahṛdi samānīya punaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā tanmayamātmānaṃ vibhāvya aiśānyāṃ nirmālya
vāsinyai nama ityabhyarca śeṣanirmalyaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā naivedya jātaṃ strībhyo dadyāt | svayañca kiñcit svīkṛtya siddhasaṅkalpaḥ yathāsukhaṃ viharet | (taduktaṃ saṅketa tantre) (-) naivedya jātaṃ yat kiñcit kaulikāyai nivedayet | naivedyaṃ strībhyo dadyānna kutracit || lambodarasya pautreṇa kamalākarasunūnā || alisvita śaṅkareṇāyaṃ nityapūjāvinirṇayaḥ || [iti pūjā nirṇaya prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[atha dvitīya paṭalaḥ] ||
atha dīkṣāvidhilikhyate | tayā vinā sarvamantrasyānadhikāritvāt | caturṣu āścameṣu dīkṣāyā āvaśyakatvaṃ taduktaṃ vārāhītantre bhagavānuvāca (-) dīkṣāmūlaṃ jagatasarvaṃ dīkṣā hi paramaṃ tapaḥ | dīkṣāmāśritya nivaset yatra kutrāśrame vasan || adīkṣito'pimaraṇe rauravānna nivartate | tasmāddikṣāṃ prayatnena proktāmāśritya tāntrikāditi || evaṃ sadgurorāhita dīkṣaḥ sarvaṃ sādhayet | taduktaṃ mahāgratārākalpe (-) kalpe dṛṣṭvā tu tārāṃ vai yo gṛhṇāti narādhamaḥ | manvantarasahasraistu niṣkṛtirneva jāyate || gurormukhānmahāvidyāṃ gṛhṇīyāt pāpanāśiṇīm |
atra gurū lakṣaṇaṃ yathā kula cūḍāmaṇau (-) kulanāthaṃ parityajya ye śāktāḥ parasevinaḥ | teṣāṃ dīkṣā ca yāgaśca abhicārāya kalpate || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena maṅgalaṃgurūmāśrayet || kulīnaḥ sarvidyānāṃ adhikāroti niścitam || dīkṣāvibhuḥ sa evātmā sarvamantrasya nāparaḥ || dīkṣā kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nīlatantrānusārataḥ || kṛṣṇa pakṣasya cāṣṭhabhyāṃ śubhalagne śubhakṣaṇe || pūrvabhādrapadāyukte mitratārādi saṃyute || athavā hyanurādhāyāṃ revatyāṃ vā praśasyate || jānīyācchobhanaṃ kālaṃ mantrasya grahaṇaṃ prati || taduktaṃ nīlatantre (-) rohiṇī śravaṇārdya ca dhaniṣṭā cottarātrayam | puṣyā śatābhiṣācaiva dīkṣānakṣatramucyate || iṣe caiva viśeṣaṇa kārtikeca viśeṣataḥ | mahāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa dharmakāmārthasiddhaye || bhāva cūḍāmaṇī (-) viṣṇurviṣṇumatasthā ye viṣṇu dīkṣā pravartakāḥ | gaṇeśo gānapatyā ye gaṇadīkṣā pravartakāḥ || śaivāḥ śāktāśca sarvatra sarva dīkṣā pravartakāḥ || guru bhaktiryathā (-) utapādaka brahmadātrorgarīyān vrahyadaḥ pitā | tasmāttamabhimanyet puturaṇyadhikaṃ gurum || ūrddhvāmnāye (-) karmamūlaṃ gurormūrtiḥ pūjāmūlaṃ guroḥ kriyā | mūlamantraṃ gurorvākyaṃ tasmādādī gurūṃ yajet || atha śiṣya yogyatā | tathā ca śrutiḥ | vidyā brāhmaṇamityāhuḥ saibādhastesmi vakṣimām | asūyakāya mā mādāttathāsyāṃ vīryavattamā || yamevatu śuciṃ vidyānniyataṃ brahmavādinam | tasmai mā bruhi viprāya nidhipāyā pramādine ||
tathā ca eka dvitricatuḥ pañcavarṣāṇyālokya yogyatām | yogyaṃ parigrahecchiṣyaṃ anyathā duḥkhamāpnuyāt || dīkṣā kālaniyamo yathā rudra jāmale (-) asiddhirbhūmisampattirmaraṇaṃ bandhunāśanam | ātmabuddhiḥ prajānāśaḥ sampatīratna sañcayaḥ || pūrṇa phalaṃ śatruvṛddhirmedhā kāmaprapūrṇatā | caitrādīnāṃ phalaṃ jñeyaṃ malamāsaṃ vivarjayet || pañcāṅgaśuddhi divase śobhane śaśitārayoḥ | guruśukrodayecaiva śasyate mantrasaṃskriyā || atha dīkṣāsthāna niyamaḥ | matasyasukte goṣṭhe śivālaye śūnye śmaśāne ca nadītaṭe | girau ca grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet siddhivāñcakaḥ || evaṃ siddhiṃ labhenmantrī nānyathā tāmavāpnuyāt | nātra kāla viśuddhyādi na ca nakṣatraśobhanam | avāṇya mantraṃ vidhivat paritoṣya tathāeurūm || yadevecchāgurodīkṣā tadaiva śubhadā matā | guroranujñāmātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati || nīlatantre (-) kramaṃ pravṛttya vidhivat pūjāddimau vidhāyaca | vidyāṃ tāṃ kathayetkarṇe jīvakarṇe ca tattvavit || atrāvaśyakattvādādau kullukāmupadiśya paścādiṣṭhamanuṃ vadet | taduktaṃ matasyasūkte (-) ajñātvā kullukāṃ devīmajaptā gurupādukām | adatvā dakṣiṇāṃ samyag kṛtvā kramapūjanam || yo'sminmatre pravarteta taṃ tvaṃ pīḍayase dhruvam | atratya homa niyamastu homaprakaraṇe jñeyam | iṣe caiva viśeṣeṇa kārtike ca viśeṣataḥ | aṣṭottara śataṃ homaṃ bilvapatreṇa kārayet || athavāṣṭhādaśaṃ kuryādaṣṭāviṃśatimeva vā | pāyasaṃ kṛṣaraṃ dadyānmodakañca saśarkaram ||
valiṃ dadyācca chāgalaṃ godhāmāṃsamanuttamam | rambhāpuṣpaṃ śālamatasyaṃ juhuyācca prayatnataḥ || yavakṣīraṃ tato dadyāt śālyannaṃ madhunā yutam | nārikela jalaṃ dadyāt saśasyaṃ tadanantaram || śarkarā saṃyutaṃ dadyāt svarṇādyābhaṇantathā | gobhuhiraṇya vastrādyaistoṣayed gurumātmanaḥ || svatantratantre dakṣinā niyamo yathā (-) gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pratyakṣāya śivātmane | sarvasvaṃ vā tadaddhambā tadarddhambā tadājñayā || naceta sañcāriṇī śakriḥ kathamasya bhaviṣyati | nīlatantre'pi (-) gurū santoṣa mātreṇa siddhirbhavati śāśvatī | anyathānaiva siddhiḥ syāt abhicārāya kalpate || gobhuhiraṇya vastrādairyathāvibhvamātmanaḥ | sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt gāśca dadyāt payasvaṇīḥ || bhūmiṃ vṛttikarīṃ dadyāt putrapautrānuyāyiṇīm | phetkārīye (-) gurūve dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt suvarṇaṃ vāsasānvitam | guroḥ santoṣamātreṇa siddhirbhavati śāśvatī || anyathā naiva siddhiḥ syādabhicārāya kalpate | viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvahumāna puraḥsaram || iti viśeṣaḥ | nīlatantre matasya sūkte ca (-) atrāvirodhi sāmānymapi kartavyamiti | tathā svatantratantre (-) tasya cchāyānusārī syānnikaṭe tridinaṃ vaset | naceta sañcāriṇī śakti gurūmeti na saṃśayaḥ ||
yasmin divase labhate manumenaṃ tatra lābhaḥ syāt | niyataṃ bhavati vyatyayaḥ sadasata karmaṇorubhayoḥ ||
[iti dīkṣāniyamo dvitīya paṭalaḥ] ||
[atha tṛtīya paṭalaḥ]
evaṃ sad gurorāhita dīkṣaḥ mantra siddhaye puraścaraṇamārabhet || tathā nīlatantre (-) jīvahīno yathā deho sarva karmasu na kṣamaḥ | puraścaraṇahīno'pi tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || japa homau tarpanañca seko brāhmaṇa bhojanam | pañcāṅgo hi loke'smin puraścaraṇamucyate || atra pañcāṅge japasya mukhyatā | anya catuṣṭyaṃ tadaṅgatve jñeyam | tanniṣpādya tadaṅgoktatvāt | gāndharve (-) evaṃ kṛtvā haviśyāśo japellakṣamananyadhoḥ | tataḥ prayogaṃ sarveṣāṃ vaśyādīnāñca kārayet || vīratantrahapi viśeṣaḥ (-) svecchācāraparo mantrī puraścaraṇasiddhaye | rahasyamālāmādāya lakṣamekaṃ sadā japet ||
pheravīye (-) jaḍo'pi yadi mūkaḥsyādbhāvanā vaśatatparaḥ | labhate śrīmatāṃ vāṇīṃ mantrasya lakṣa jāpataḥ || śrīmatāṃ vyāsavaśiṣṭhādīnāṃ vākyaṃ prāṇya kavayo bhārarādiṃ pracakrire ityuktvatvāt | iha tu bhāvanā śaktānāṃ tattadācāraviratānāñcaturguṇaṃ japamāmananti | taduktamekavīrātantre bhāvanārahitānāntu kṣudrānāṃ kṣudracetasām | caturguṇa japaḥ prokta siddhaye nānyathā bhavet || evaṃ mahācīnakramāśaktānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāmapi caturguṇavidhānena japaḥ kāryaḥ | jaḍo'pi yadimūkaḥsyādbhāvanāvaśatatpara iti śravaṇāt | anyatrāpi (-) rahasyamārganiratāḥ sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ | tadanuṣṭānaviratāḥ sarve varṇāṃ pṛthaka pṛthak || atra yathoktācāra siddhavidyayoścaturguṇa yuga sevā pariśramo nāsti | taduktaṃ phetkārīye (-) viśeṣataḥ kaliyūge matprasādāt bhaviṣyati | matysasūkte'pi siddhamantratayā nātra yugasevā pariśramaḥ | puraścaraṇakāle tadācāra māha (-) naktaṃ bhojī haviṣyānnaṃ japedvidyāṃ divā śuciḥ | tatkṛtvā siddhimāpnoti japecca manasā sthiram || tathāca gūḍha pādācāryaiḥ (-) bhūmau śayyā vacasi niyamaḥ kāminībhyo nivṛttiḥ prātarjāto viṭapasamidhā danta jihvā viśuddhiḥ | patrāvalyāṃ madhuramaśanaṃ brahmavṛkṣasya puṣpaiḥ pūjāhomau kusuma rasanālepanānyujajvalāni || mantrakāle ca satataṃ bhāryāṃ yatnena varjayet | varjayedviṣṇukalpañca varjayet tulasī dalam ||
varjayenmālatī puṣpaṃ varjayedanya pūjanam | hasta prakṣālanaṃ śaucamācāntastattadācaret || devīnāñca tathā puṣpaṃ pṛthak pātraṃ niyojayet || ekaṃ bhāvaṃ na kartavyaṃ yadīcchet siddhimātmānaḥ | naivedyādi phalaistoyairjānīyadeṣadeva bhāk || havirnānāvidhai gandhaiḥ pāyasai modakādibhiḥ | evaṃ krameṇa yuñjīta dadhikṣīraṃ tathaiva ca || rahasya mālā yathā phetkārīye (-) akasmādīhitā siddhimahāśaṅkhākhya mālayā | pañcāśanmaṇibhirmālā nirmitā sarvasiddhidā || mahāśaṅkha nīlasarasvatī mantraḥ śīghraphalado bhavati | nṛlalāṭāsthyabhāve ghaṭanā sākaryanimittaṃ dehāntarasyāpi asthiprāhyam | iti śaivadīkṣāntargata ṭīkā | athamālā saṃskāro yathā | ekavīrā kalpe syūtāmbā grathitāmvāpi dvijastrīsūtra nirmitām | mukhe mukhantu saṃyojya pucche pucchaṃ niyojayet || sarpākṛtiryathāmālā gopucchākṛtireva vā | mātṛkā varṇato granthiṃ vidyayā vātha kārayet || tatasajātīya mekākṣaṃ merūtvena prakalpayet | evaṃ sā grathitā mālā mantra siddhi pradāyinī || śubhe lagne śubhe vāre śubharkṣeca śubhe tithau | pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayenmantrī svayambā guruṇāpi vā || āśvatthapatra navakaṃ padamākāreṇa kalpayet | tatra saṃsthāpayenmantrī mātṛkāmantramuccaraṇ ||
vahniṃ saṃskṛtya vidhivadaṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet | hutiśeṣaṃ pratihutau pradadyāddevatāpriyam || tatra devīṃ samabhyarcya grahānapi ca pūjayet | anuloma vilomena mātṛkārṇena mantrayet || meruṃ pretena saṃmantrya bhāvayeddevatātmakām | evaṃ sarvaguṇopetā jāyate sarvasiddhaye || taduktaṃ śāmbhavīye (-) syūta sūtraṃ vīti hotraṃ āvṛttidvitayaṃ punaḥ | divā niśākarau proktau tasmāttejastrayī śubhā || tādṛśyākṣasṛjā yastu kurute japamuttamam || apamṛtyu kalibhyāṃ samucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || gopanīye yamaniśaṃ japamālepsitāptaye || karamālā nirṇayo yathā | taduktaṃ haṃsa pārameśvare parvadvayamanāmāyāḥ parivartana vai kramāt | parvatrayaṃ madhyamāyāstarjanyekaṃ samāharet || athameru laṅghane dūṣaṇaṃ yathā śaktimālā samākhyātā sarvamantra pradīpikā | atrāpivyagracittena yajjaptaṃ yajjaptaṃ merulaṅghanāt || tat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ yāti ityājñā parameśvari | parvadvayantu tarjanyā meruṃ tadviddhi pārvati || siddhaye sādhako meruṃ japennatvā punaḥ punaḥ | tarjanyagraṃ tathā madhyaṃ yo japet so'pi pāpakṛt || taduktaṃ ekavīrātantre (-) kullukāṃ ca tato natvā mālā pūjāṃ vidhāya ca | gṛhṇīyāddakṣiṇenātha na ca vāmena saṃspṛśet || nābhitaśca śiradeśe kullukāṃ paricintayet | bhaṭṭasūtrakṛtā mālā devyāḥ prītikaro sadā || athavā mahāśaṅkhābhāve pañcāśanmaṇinirmitayā sphāṭikādi mālayā japet | atha parama yogināṃ rahasyātirahasyamālā likhyate | taduktaṃ viśuddheśvaratantre (-)
mālāṃ vidhānaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu pārvati tatvataḥ | yena vijñānamātreṇa mantrāḥ sidhyanti tat kṣaṇāt || anuloma vilomena mantramātra vibhedataḥ | mantreṇāntaritān varṇān varṇanāntaritaṃ manum || kuyyādvarṇamayīṃ mālāṃ sarvamantrapradīpanīm | caramārṇaṃ merurūpaṃ laṅghayenna ca sarvadā || meruḥ śiraśca sarveṣāṃ yathā deveṣvahaṃ hariḥ | (matsyasūkte) tasmāttat sthiracittena karma kuryādaharniśam | etat paramarahasyaṃ mayoktante yaśasvini | tvayā guptataraṃ kāryaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || tataḥ siddhaye sarvadā gurubhaktimaṅgīkṛtya uttarābhimukhaḥ śirasi kullukāṃ dhyātvā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ japet | taduktaṃ phetkārīye (-) gurucaraṇa saroja sarvadā bhakti bhāvāt paricarati vidheyo vāsya sarvātmanā syāt | anudinamanumenaṃ mānayan mānavo'sau bhavati jagati vādī dvaita siddhāntahantā || tathā ca matsya ukte (-) kullukāñca na jānāti mahāmantraṃ japennaraḥ | (yāvajjivantu japtavyaṃ na sidhyati kadācana || mahāmantraṃ parityajya pūjayed yastu tāriṇīm |) pañcatvaṃ jāyate tasya athavā vātulobhavet || tāriṇyāścaṇḍikāyāśca mantraḥ kulluka varjitaḥ | matimān yo dvijātīnāṃ nopāste sa kadācana || kullukāñca śire dhṛtvā sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || māyātantre'pi (-) kullukāṃ dhārayecchiṣe likhitvābhūrjapatrake |
sabhāyāñca rājadvāre vijayī bhavati dhruvam | nānyo vicāraḥ sarvatra virūpākṣasya sammataḥ || kulluke varjite puṃsāṃ yajñe nopasthitirbhavet | mama pūjā sadā vyarthā mama yajñaṃ tathaiva ca || tārāmantrasya sāmānyaṃ tryakṣaraṃ mantramuttamam | na jānāti ca yo mūḍhaḥ kullukāṃ hāriṇīṃ yajet || yāvajjivantu japtvāpi na sidhyati kadācana | mahāmantraṃ parityajya pūjayed yastu tāriṇīm || pañcatvaṃ jāyate tasya athavā vātulo bhavet | (kullukā nāma sā devī anubhāva svarūpiṇī || śarāsana kartṛhastā caturbāhu samanvitā | nīlotpalavapuḥ śyāmā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā || likhettu tryakṣaraṃ mantraṃ haridrācandanena vā | yāvajjīvamatandrākṣaṃ śikhāyā dhārayet sadā || mahatyā vidyayā prāptaṃ japenmantraṃ trilakṣakam ||) evaṃ pūrvoktasthānādikamanusandheyam | evamuktena japtvā taddaśāṃśena homatarpaṇābhiṣeka brāhmaṇa bhojanagurudakṣiṇāśca samācaret | taduktam | lakṣamekaṃ japedvidyāṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ | uktasthāneṣu ca tathā tattadāsana saṃsthitaḥ || pūrvoktaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā viprārādhana tatparaḥ | anantaraṃ daśāṃśena kramāddhomādikaṃ caret || rātrau baliḥ sadā deyaḥ sarvasiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ | puraścaraṇa homastu nīlotpalena bilvapatrena vā vidheyaḥ | taduktaṃ siddhasārasvate | evaṃ japaṃ yathā kṛtvā daśāṃśamasitot palaiḥ | ājyāktai juhuyānmantrī taddaśāṃśena tarpayet || kālāgurudravīpetai vimalairgandhavāribhiḥ | tarpayettāṃ parāṃ devīṃ tatprakāramihocyate ||
jale cāvāhya vidhivat pādyādyairudagātmakaiḥ | sampūjya vidhivaddevīṃ parivārān sakṛt sakṛt || santarpya vidhivad bhaktyā daśāṃśaṃ tarpayet tataḥ | punarekaikaṃ santarpya parivārāṃstathā punaḥ || abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tata prakāraṃ śṛṇuṣva me | devībuddhyā svamātmānaṃ saṃpūjya sādhakottamaḥ || tāriṇīṃ siñcayāmīti namo mūrddhani niḥkṣipet | abhiṣeko'yamākhyātaḥ sarvapāpa nikṛntanaḥ || abhiṣeka daśāṃśena sādhakānāñca bhojanam | svavāsinīṃ kumārīñca bhojayet tadanantaram || kṣīrakhaṇḍājya bhojyaiśca mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam | guruve dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvahumāna puraḥsaram || iti nīlatārātantre | urddhāmnāye'pi (-) homatarpanayoḥ svāhā nyāsapūjanayornamaḥ | mantrānte nāma coccārya tarpayāmi tataḥparam || svāhānte tarpanaseyvaṃ abhiṣekaṃ śṛṇuṣva me | mantrānte nāma coccārya siñcayāmi tataḥ param || taddaśāśaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ samupācaret | ityevaṃ mantrasiddhaḥ san sarva kāmāśca sādhayet || matsya sūkte'pi (-) akṣataṃ bilvapatrañca daśāṃśaṃ jahuyāttataḥ | kevalaṃ tilājyamitiguravaḥ | gurave dakṣiṇāñca dadyāt | tathā | ajñātvā kullukāṃ devīmayaṣṭvā gurupādukām | na datvā dakṣiṇāṃ samyag kṛtvā kramapūjanam || yo'smin mantre pravartate taṃ tvaṃ pīḍayasidhruvam | ityādi matsyasūkta vacanāt | [iti puraścaraṇa nirṇayaḥ tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[caturtha paṭalaḥ]
atha naimittikānuṣṭhānam | yathā uktaṃ svatantratantre | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ sāpekṣaṃ pūrva pūrvataḥ | anyathā cedbhaveditthaṃ kuryādāpat pāmparām || nīlatantre (-) nityāccanarato mantrī kryānnaimittikārcanam | naimittikārcane siddhe kuryāt kāmyam khaṇḍitam || tadyathāmatsyasūkte (-) aṣṭmyācca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayecca prayatnataḥ | yad yat prārtayate mantrī tattadāpnoti nityaśaḥ || labhate mañjulāṃ vāṇīṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ sadā yajet | atra nityārcanānataraṃ naimittikaṃ kāryam | yatra kālaniyamā na dṛśyate tatra māsambā maṇḍalambā vyāpya naimittikādyanuṣṭhānameva marṣanīyamiti | tathācokta rudrajāmale (-) māsārddhamathavā māsaṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tathā | yāvat phalāptivān yogo tāvadevaṃ samācaret || anyatrāpi (-) naimittike tathā kāmye phalāptirmaṇḍalāvadhiḥ | nacet tadviguṇaṃ kuryād yathā syāt phalabhāk sudhīḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ devyāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam | rambhā puṣpaṃ bījapūraṃ sugandhi parimiśritam ||
miśrīkṛtya baliṃ dadyādaṣṭamyāñca viśeṣataḥ | svarṇamālāṃ mahādevyai dadyādgandhau viśeṣataḥ || phalaṃ kṣīraṃ tathā dadyādadhikaṃ śarkarānvitam | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sampattyai pūjayecchivām || taṇḍulākṣayyasiddhārthaṃ dadyāddevyai prayatnataḥ | tathā nīlatantre (-) aṣṭamyāñca caturddśyāṃ pūjayecca yathāvidhiḥ | ājñā siddhimavāpnoti javāpuṣpañca varvarām || candanañcākaṃ kusumaṃ dadyācchvetāparājitām || arghya dadyādviśeṣeṇa nityapūjāsu sarvadā || aṣṭottara śataṃ jāpyaṃ yāvajjivita saṃkhyayā | yastu sampūjayed durgāṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ prayatnataḥ || sa trijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva nāśayet | durgāṃ tāriṇīmiti prakaraṇānukūlatvāt | ye yajanti mahāmāyāṃ jñātvā tattvena bhairava | ājñāsiddhimavāpyante dhruvaṃ yānti śivālayam || matsyasūkte'pi (-) tāriṇī yatra pīṭhetu śilārūpā ca tiṣṭhati | tatra yatnena gantavyaṃ phalasaṃkhyā na vidyate || lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantrī tāriṇāṃ yatra tiṣṭhati | sthiracittena manasā siddhirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt || saṃkhyākṛtāṃ mṛttikāñca akṣatañca tathaiva ca | madhunā pāyasañcaiva kṣīraṃ sājyañca śarkarām || baliṃ dadyācca godhāṃ vai āsavañca praśaśyate | nīlatantre'pi (-) yatrāsarvamavaśyantu brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ | tatra guḍārdrakaṃ dadyāt takraṃ vā guḍamiśritam ||
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre vā visṛjenmadhu | rambhāpuṣpaṃ śalamatsyaṃ juhuyānmantravittamaḥ || sarvasiddhimanukramya cānte mokṣamavāpnuyāt | sākṣataṃ vilvapatrañca juhuyācca sahasrakam || labhate mañjulāṃ vāṇīṃ mahāṣṭamyāñca sādhakaḥ || tathā mantra cūḍāmaṇau (-) kulavāre kulāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | yoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanam || yathā viṣṇutithau viṣṇuḥ pūjito vāñcitapradaḥ || tathā kulatithau śktiḥ pūjitā varadāyinī || tathā matsyasūkte (-) aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayecca viśeṣataḥ | śaṅkhasthitaṃ toyaṃ pūraṃ javāpuṣpañca varvarām || candanañcākakusumaṃ śvetāñcaivāparājitām | annadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa nitya pūjavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || aṣṭottaraśataṃ jāpyaṃ yāvajjīvita saṃkhyayā | sahasraṃ vā japedevaṃ nityapūjāvidhau śṛṇu || mahogrāyāḥ sadā pūjyā pūjane kullukā parā | stotra mantra vratādīnāṃ anuṣṭhāne ca sarvadā || ananuṣṭhānatastasyāḥ sarvaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet | mahāvidyāñca sandhāyya vāsudevañca yo'rcayet || prāpnoti tatphalaṃ samyak hari sāyujya māpnuyāt | vāsudevo haro brahmā rāriṇī prakṛtiḥ sadā || ekamūrtiḥ sadā cintyā ekamūrtiḥ sadā sthitā | svargamokṣapradā devī jayavidyā pradāyinī | tasmāttāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpakaiḥ || naivedyarvividhayrbhaktyā pūjayet tāriṇīṃ sadā |
atha naimittike viśeṣārcanaṃ yathā māyātantre (-) āṣāḍhe śayanaṃ kuryāt siṃhe ca parivartanam | āśvine bodhayeddevīṃ paśu pāyasa modakaiḥ || rātrau prabodhena varaṃ jāyate sura sundari | divā prabodhena tathā svapanehapi ca jāyate || śuklāṣṭamyāṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ ghaṭāṣṭamyāṃ ghaṭasya ca | māghasya meṣasya ca vibhorātrau sampūjayet sudhīḥ || atha pīṭhārchanaṃ nīlatantre pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalam | tatra yat kriyate pūjā sakṛdvāpi maheśvara || vihāya sarvapīṭhāni tasya dehe vasāmyaham || tasmāccataguṇaṃ proktaṃ kāmākhyā yoni maṇḍalam | teṣāṃ phalaṃ mahādeva vahu kiṃ kathyate'dhunā || yatra koṭiganaiḥ sārddha mādyā vasati tāriṇī | yat pīṭhaṃ brahmaṇo vaktraṃ guptaṃ sarvasukhāvaham || yato devāśca vedāśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥ | sarvaṃ pravibhavantyatra tena guptaṃ sadākuru || dvividhañcaiva tat pīṭhaṃ guptaṃ vyaktaṃ maheśvara | vyāktād guptaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ durāpaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ || guptaṃ sarvatra deveśa labhate kulasundaraiḥ | atha kulapūjāmāh tantracuḍāmaṇau (-) ekaścet kulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra bhairavaḥ | sarva eva surāḥ pūjyā satyaṃ brahmaśivādayaḥ || ekā ced yuvatī tatra pūjitā cāvallokitā | sarvā eva parā devya pūjitā kulabhairava || ādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūtau viśeṣataḥ | na pūjayati cet kāntāṃ tadā vighnervilupyate ||
taduktaṃ rudrajāmale (-) pṛthivīṃ śasyasampūrṇāṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage | datvā yat phalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kolikārcanāt | annadāna sahasrebhyaḥ śatebhyo yajvanāmapi | teṣāṃ bhojana dānena tat phalaṃ kaulbhojanāt || aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca | merutulyaṃ suvarṇañca brāhmaṇe veda pārage || datvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kolikārcanāt | iṣṭvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ deśikārcanāt || vāpīkūpataḍāgādi kṛtvā ca śivakṛṣṇayoḥ | dānād yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ deśikārcanāt || iti saṃkṣepaḥ | pūrvārjjita phalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmani | haṃsa pārameśvare (-) naraśaktiḥ paśuśakiḥ pakṣaśaktiśca bhairava | pūjitā viguṇaṃ karma saguṇaṃ sādhayed yataḥ || puraścaraṇa kāle tu yadi syāt pīṭha darśanam | tadā tatra pīṭha pūjā manasāpi na hīyate || devīkoṭai mahābhāgāmuḍḍīyāne ca bhairavīm | yoganidrāṃ kāmarūpe mahiṣāsuramardinīm || kātyāyanīṃ kāmabhūtau kāmākhyāṃ kāmadāyinīm | jālandhare ca pūrṇāśīṃ pūrṇaśaile ca caṇḍikām || kāmarūpe tato deva pujyā dikkara vāsinī | athavā kāmarūpasya darśanaṃ yadi bhāgyataḥ || tadā bhagādidevināṃ pūjā tatra vidhīyate | kulavāre kulaṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśā viśeṣayaḥ ||

utthitaṃ māraṇe dhyāyet suptamuccāṭane smṛtam || upaviṣṭaṃ sureśāni vaśyādau paricintayet | āsīnaṃ śvetavarṇañca śāntike paricintayet || vāma (yāna) mārgasthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tāmasaṃ parikīrtitam | sātvakaṃ mokṣakāmānāṃ rājasaṃ rājyamicchatām || tāmasaṃ śatrunāśārthaṃ sarva vyādhi nivāraṇam | māraṇe viṣasaṃhāre grahabhuta nivāraṇe | uccāṭane ca vidveṣe pañcavarṇa prayujyate || antenāma bha(*?)nmatraḥ pārśvataḥ parikīrtitaḥ | mantrānte nāma saṃsthānaṃ yoga ityabhidhīyate || śāntike pauṣṭike baśye prāyaścitta viśodhane | mohane dīpane yogaṃ payuñjanti maṇīṣinaḥ || stambhanoccāṭanoccheda vidvaṣesu sa cocyate | nāmna ādyantamadhye ca mantraḥ syād yoga ucyate || mantrābhimukhyakaraṇe sarvapāpa nivāraṇe | jvara graha viṣakṛtyā śāntike ca sa cocyate || sammelane sa evātha mantrānāmakṣarāṇi ca | ekaikāntaritaṃ yattu grathanaṃ tat prakīrtitam || tacchāntike vidhātavyaṃ nāmādhyante yadā manuḥ | tat sampuṭo bhavet tattu kīlakaṃ paribhāṣitam || sthambha(ḥ) mṛtyuñjaye diṣṭho rakṣaṇādiṣu saṃpuṭaḥ | dviṣi (dvo dvo) mantrākṣaraṃ tasya madhye nāmākṣaraṃ kramāt || grathyate sa vidarbhastu vaśyākarṣaṇa pauṣṭike || evaṃ yogakramaḥ proktaḥ karmakāle manīṣibhiḥ | vahnikārya japet svāhā namaḥ sarvatra cārcane ||
śānti puṣṭivaśadveṣeṣuccāṭane ca māraṇe | svadhā svāhā vaṣṭh hucca voṣaṭ phaṭkāraṃ kramāt || padmāsanaṃ pauṣṭiketu śāntike svastikāsanam | ākṛṣṭau pārṣṇikaṃ tadvad vidveṣe śatru nigrahe || sarva svastikamuccāṭe māraṇādau praśasyate | śānti pauṣṭikavaśye tu sundarī śobhanāśayā || sarvābharaṇa saṃdīptā prāprakāmamānovyathā (rathā) | dyātavyā devatā samyak suprasannānanāmbujā || ākarṣaṇe ca tadvacca māraṇe ca praśaśyate | sādhya ākarṣaṇe dveṣe bhartasyamāno janairapi | ardyamāno janairdaṇḍairgrasitastakṣake na tu | ulūka vāyasāviṣṭe grasta uccāṭane ripuḥ | japecca śavamārūḍhya sandaṣṭhauṣṭhapuṭaḥ krudha || karma kuryād yathā nyāyaṃ mantrī krureṣu karmasu | pauṣṭhikādīni karmāṇi yadvāra tithi yogataḥ || prayoktavyāni vidhinā tacca saṃprocyate'dhunā | pañcamī ca dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā saptamī tathā || budhejyavāra saṃyuktā śānti karmaṇi pūjitā | navamī pauṣṭike śastā aṣṭamī saptamī tathā || daśamyekādaśī caiva bhānuśukrādisaṃyutā | ākarṣaṇe'pyamāvasyā navamī pratipat tathā || paurṇamāsī mandabhānu yuktā vidveṣakarmaṇi | kṛṣṇā caturdaśī tadvadaṣṭamī mandatārakā | uccāṭane tithiḥśasthā pradoṣe na viśeṣataḥ || caturdaśyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇā amāvasyā tathaiva ca || mandabhaumadinopetā śastā māraṇa karmaṇi | budhacandradinopetā pañcamī daśamī tathā ||
paurṇamāsī ca vijñeyā tithiḥ stambhana karmaṇi | śubhagrahodaye kuryāt śubhāni ca śubhodaye || raudrakarmaṇi riktārke mṛtyuyoge ca māraṇam | tarpaṇaṃ matsyasūkte madhunā tarpaṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāma prapūrakam | mantra siddhikaraṃ sākṣāt mahāpātaka nāśanam || nīlatantrehapi karpūra miśritaistoyairmāsa mātraṃ hi tarpayet | vaśīkṛtya nṛpān sarvānabhogī syād yāvadāyuṣam || ghṛtaiḥ pūrṇayaśaḥ siddhairdugdhai vārogaya siddhaye | agarūmiśritai sthoyaiḥ sarva kālaṃ sukhī bhavet || nārikelodakai miśreḥ stoyaiḥ sarvārtha siddhayai || marīcamiśritaṃ ruṣṇatoyaiḥ śatrun vināśayet || kevalairuṣṇatoyeśca śatūnuccāṭayet kṣaṇāt | jvarāviṣṭo bhavettena dugdhasekāta samaṃ nayet || atraiva japaprakāraḥ | taduktaṃ nīlatantre haviṣyāśī muktakeśī japyādayuta mādarāt | gadya padyamayī vāṇī tasya sarva vidhā bhavet || dhyānastu tatraiva uccāṭayati piṅgākṣī saṃtrāsayati kekarā | vidrāvayati muktāsyā saṃtrāsayati ghurṇitā || vikṣobhayati saṃkṣubdhā sampādayati sammatā | saṅkocayati saṃruddhā vipralabdhā prabodhayet || phetkārīye'pi atra sarvasya kartavyaṃ bhāvanāmantra cintanam | ahoccāṭanādiṣu (sarvadā) sarvatraivāyutojapaḥ | taduktaṃ siddhasārasvate (-) śatābhijaptamātreṇa rocanā tilakaṃ naraḥ | kṛtvāpaśyati yaṃ mantrī taṃ kuryāddāsavat sudhīḥ ||
phetkārīye'pi puṣkariṇyājale'gādhe yaṣṭhi kāṣṭhaṃ tamo gṛhe | dantenānīya tattūrṇaṃ kīlakaṃ tena kārayet || tenaiva madhu ghṛtāktena padminī patramātrake | likhet sūtrāvalīmadhye mūlamantra vidarbhitam || tat kuṇḍe caturasre tu niḥkṣipya juhuyadapi | sahasraṃ kṣīranīrāktaṃ padmānāṃ lohitadviṣām || asyārthaḥ (-) tamogṛhe rāhugraste niśākare sūrye vā | niḥkṣipyeti kuṇḍamadhye dvādaśāṅgulādhobhāge niḥkṣipedityarthaḥ | mūlamantravidarbhitamiti | mūlamantrasya hṛllekhārephamadhye mama druta kavitva siddhiṃ kuru kuru ityākhyāsahitaṃ likhet | tataḥ prayogāntaram | padmāvatī mantreṇa baliṃ dadyāt catuṣpathe | a(/) padmaṃ padme mahāpadme padmāvati māye svāhā iti mantreṇa yathāpūrvaṃ naimittikapaṭaloktaṃ baliṃ dadyāt | taduktaṃ phetkārīye praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya padme yugmaṃ tathaiva ca | mahāpadme padaṃ brūyat padmāvati padaṃ tataḥ || māye svāheti mantreṇa yathāpūrvaṃ valiṃ haret | evaṃ yaḥ kurute karma sasyād drutakavi naraḥ || atha sakala siddhaye vakṣyamāna valimantreṇa nityapūjoktavalimantreṇa vā rātrau catuṣpathe valiṃ dadyāt | taduktaṃ phetkārīye (-) upacāra viśeṣeṇa rājapatrīṃ vaśaṃ nayet | rājānaṃ japamātreṇa valinā sakalaṃ jagat || asyārthaḥ upacāra viśeṣeṇeti | taduktaṃ matsyasūkte rambhājātī bījapūraṃ sugandhi parimiśritam | miśrīkṛtya valiṃ dadyāt aṣṭamyāñca viśeṣataḥ || rājānaṃ japamātreti pūjādirahitenaiveti yāvat | yogaprayogādipallavena rājā vaśyo bhavati | valinā sakalaṃ jagaditi | matsya sūktokta naimittikapaṭalānu sandhānena boddhavyam | duktaṃ nīlatantre |
prayoge valimantro'yaṃ prayogāt sādhayed yadi | arddharātre tato nityaṃ valiṃ dadyāccatuṣpathe || parasainya grahāriṣṭa rogakṛtyā nivāriṇaḥ | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya ugratāre tataḥ param || vikaṭadaṃṣṭre parapakṣaṃ mohayadvayamuccaret | māraya khādaya paca tathā dvayaṃ dvayaṃ vadet || ye māṃ hiṃsitumudyatāḥ yoginī cakrai | stān hāvaya hū(/) phaṭ svāhā paravidyāmākarṣaya chedaya kapāle gṛhna (6) svāheti tanmanunā balimantrenāpyātha ca valiṃ dadyāt yathāruciḥ | prasaṅgādatra chāgādi validānam | yathā kālitantre | sulakṣaṇaṃ paśuṃ devyagre saṃsthāpyākhyordakena saṃprokṣyāstreṇa saṃrakṣya kavacenāvagunṭhya dhenumudrayā'mṛtokṛtya karṇe dhṛtvā imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhet | gandhapuṣpaiśca saṃpūjya paśupāśāya viṃmahe viśvakarmaṇe dhīmahi tanno jīvaḥ pracodayāt | drī(/) kāli kāli vrajreśvarilo'daṇaḍāyai nama iti saṃpūjya khaḍagaṃ pūjayet | hū(/) vāgaśvarī brahmamyāṃ namaḥ | hū(/) lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhyāṃ namaḥ | hū(/) umā maheśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti mantrena brahmāviṣṇuśiva śaktyuktāya khaḍagāya namaḥ | iti dhṛtvā saṃpūjya a(/) khaḍagāya svaranāśāya śaktikāryārtha tatpara | paśuścedyastvayā śīghraṃ khaḍaganātha namo'stute | tato mūlamantreṇa dūrvākṣata pānīyaṃ gṛhītvā dīrghāyuṣṭva durbhikṣa duḥkha nivṛtti paramapadagamana pūrvaka śāśvata samāvacchinna harṣaṃ vijayakāmaḥ śrīmannīlasarasvati imaṃ paśuṃ tubhyamahaṃdade | devyājñāṃ prārthya paśuṃ nivedayet | yathoktena vidhānena tuhyamastusamarpitam | tataścenne dakṣiṇe patite vṛddirvāmabhāge ca ninditam | dainyaṃ madhye ca patitaṃ devi ccheddaṃsmaredbudhaḥ ||
tataḥ kuṇḍāntike gatvā hutibhirdaśa pañcabhiḥ | tenaiva tu sṛjan doṣaṃ baliṃ lakṣaṃ sulakṣaṇam || tato rudhira māṃsa bhaktānvitaṃ baṭūkayoginī kṣetrapāla gaṇeśādīnāṃ mantrairvaliṃ haret | āgneyyāṃ hu(/) vāṃ vaṭuka bhairavāya nama iti gandhākṣata kusumaiḥ saṃpūjya vāyavye hūṃ yāṃ yoginībhya namaḥ | iti gandhākṣata kusumaiḥ saṃpūjya īśāne hūṃ kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya nama iti gandhākṣata kusumaiḥ saṃpūjyarnaiṛte hūṃ gāṃ gaṇeśāya nama iti gandha puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya valiṃ dadyāt | śmaśānāṅgāra mādāya maṅgale vāsare niśi | kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭyavadhniyāt raktatantunā | śatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣipedvaira veśmani | saptehābhyantare teṣāmuccāṭanamidaṃ mahat || taduktaṃ phetkārīye narāsthani likhenmantraṃ kṣārayuktaṃ haridrayā | sahasraṃ parisaṃjapya niśāyāṃ śanivāsare || kṣipyate yasya gehetu mṛtyustasya trimāsataḥ | kṣetre tu śasyahāniḥ syājjavahānisturaṅgame || dhanahānirdhanāgāre grāma madhye tu tatkṣayaḥ | kṣārantu śyaina viṭyukta ṣaṭlavaṇam | hṛllekhādhopatarephamadhye amukāmukavordveṣaṃ kuru kuru iti || taduktaṃ nīlatantre dveṣe tu vilikhenmantraṃ pretakarpaṭake sudhīḥ | dveṣya dveṣakayornāmnī tasya dveṣī mahān bhavet || likhenmantramiti | mantraṃ likhitvā hṛllekhārephamadhye amukaṃ māraya māraya ityādi sādhya sahitamityarthaḥ | athavā sādhyaṃ likhitvā tadante mantraṃ likhet | sahasraṃ parijapyeti | amukaṃ māraya māraya ityante mantrajāpaḥ | dveṣe tu

mūlamantraṃ likhenmantrī yasyoṣṭe śvetadūrvayā | vākyīccaraṇa mātreṇa vāgmī drutakavirbhavet || tatraiva janma saṃskāra kaṃ nāma putre jāte praśasyate | jihvāyāntu likhenmantraṃ yajñadāruśalākayā || vāratrayantu sammārjya dakṣiṇe naiva pāninā | mantramuccarya pratyekaṃ paṃktiṃ kuryāt suśobhanām || ādau saṃskāraḥ kartavya stadante vilikhenmanum | gandhacandana puṣpaiśca tadante pūjayecchivām || uttarābhimukhī bhūtvā sthāpayet pīṭhauttamam | pūjayettāriṇīṃ devīṃ nānābhakṣyeḥ suśobhanaiḥ | kavirvāgmī bhavet putraḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || purbhrātā likhenmantraṃ māturbhrātā tathaiva ca | pitā caiva likenmantraṃ nānya eva kadācana || mātuḥ kroḍe tu saṃsthāpya vastrenāstīrya yatnataḥ | śāntiṃ kuryādvālakasya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃyataḥ || yathā imaṃ putraṃ kāmayata kāmajānāṃ iheveti | devebhyaḥ puṣṇāti sarvamidaṃ sajjanaṃ śivaśānti stārāyai keśavebhya stārāyai (rudrebhya stārāyai) śivāya śivayaśase || mantralikhanānte svastyayena śāntiṃ kuryāt | tatastasya mātuḥkarṇe śāntistotraṃ paṭhet | yathā tāsāṃ savyeṣu karṇeṣu tataḥ stotraṃ samācaret | mātardevi namaste'stu brahmarūpadhare'naghe || kṛṣayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayacchame | māheśi varade devi paramānandarūpiṇī ||

atha mahācīnakrama bhāvanādhīnāḥ siddhayaścāsmin tantre sarve prati pāditāḥ samprati tad yathā | taduktaṃ tārāṇave | devyuvāca | mahācīnakramaṃ deva kathitaṃ bhuvi durlabham | gāndharvañca tathā cīnaṃ yad yad guptataraṃ mahat || mahācīnakramaṃ deva sṛcitaṃ na prakāśitam | kathayasva tadedānīṃ yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || śrībhagavāna uvāca | mahācīna kramaṃ devi sarvatantreṣu gopitam | na vaktavyaṃ tribhuvane śuddhabhāvena bhāvini || kecciddevā narāḥ kecit dānavā yakṣa rākṣasāḥ | nāgalokāḥ kinnarāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || yevā paśugaṇāḥ pakṣāḥ ye kecijjagatī gatāḥ | ete jaḍatarāḥ sarva parasparakhalātmakāḥ || kukalpanaratāḥ sarve kumārgadarśanyotsukāḥ ||

namaste śivarūpāya namaste gururūpiṇe | namaste varada svāmin karuṇā nidhaye namaḥ || nānyadevaratā ye ca ye ca tvatpāda kāṅkhinaḥ | teṣāmevādhikaṃ phalaṃ madbhaktānāṃ vyavasthitam || siṃhavyāghrādayo ye ca ye ca vighnānukāriṇaḥ | ripavaśca tathā sarve ye cānye duṣṭa jantavaḥ || te sare vialayaṃ yānti pataṅgā iva pāvake | dehaṃ dīpaśikhākāraṃ dṛśyate duṣṭa jantubhiḥ || kevalaṃ premabhāvena tvayeva vibhunā prabho | kiṃvā śivamayau bhūtvā āsane pañcadevatāḥ || pṛthivī jalatāṃ yāti jalastejomayaṃ bhavet | tejo vāyau tathā vāyurākāśaṃ tat prakāśakam || dānavā rākṣasāḥ sarve ye cānye devatāgaṇāḥ | rājānaśca tathā cāndhe sarvaṃ tvat padavartinaḥ || ājñāṃ bhajanti gandharvāḥ keṣunarnarakiṅkarāḥ | yatra yatra bhavedvāñchā tattat siddhiḥ karesthitā | sadā taṃ gopinī vāṇī bhayād bhajati niścalā || dvandabhāvaṃ parityajya kimanyadvahurjalpitaḥ || mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt | ante ca jāyate gaurīloke śiva ivāparaḥ || siddhābhavantu madbhaktāḥ kathayasva mamāgrataḥ | na vaktavyamabhaktāya parabhaktāya pāpine ||
bhagavānuvāca | mahācīna kramaṃ devi trividhaṃ kathitaṃ bhuvi | taduktaṃ vīratante | snānādi mānasaṃ śaucaṃ mānasaḥ praṇavojapaḥ || pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ kalpanādikam | sarva eva śubhaḥ kālo nāśubho vidyate kvacit | n viśeṣo divārātro na sandhyāyāṃ mahāniśi || vastrādyamānasaṃ śaucaṃ dehasparśādi vāriṇaḥ | śuddhiṃ nacācaredatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaret || nātra śuddherapekṣā vā nacāmedhyādi dūṣaṇam | ya evaṃ cintayenmantrī sarvakāma samṛddidam || gadya padyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyate | tasya darśana mātreṇa vādino niṣprabhā matā || rājāno'pihi dāsatvaṃ bhajante kiṃ pare janāḥ || sarvadā pūjayeddevīmasnātaḥ kṛta bhojanaḥ || mahāniśyaśucau deśe balimantreṇa dāpayet | strīdveṣo naiva kartavyo viśeṣāt pūjanaṃ striyaḥ || japasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyorddhaṃ japañcaret | striyaṃ gacchan spṛśan paśyan yatra kutrāṇyacūḍake || bhakṣyaṃ tāmbula manyāṃśca bhakṣyadravyān yathārucīn | matsa māṃsa dadhi kṣaudra bhakṣyadravyān yathārucīn || bhakṣyānyaśeṣarūpāṇi bhuktā bhakṣyaṃ japejjapam | dikkāla niyamonātra sthityādiniyamo na ca || na jāpakālaniyamo nārcādiṣu baliṣvapi | svecchāniyamo ukto'tra mahāmantrasya sādhane ||
tithi drumeṇa saṃkhyābhirlatābhirveṣṭito yadi | tadā māsena siddhiḥ syāt sahasraṃ japamānataḥ || aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ dviguṇaṃ yadi japyate | tadaiva mahatī siddhirdavānāmapi durlabhā || mahācīnadrume bījaṃ likhitvā kuṅkumena ca | tat pārśve sādhyamālikhya tāḍayed dṛṣṭi vṛṣṭibhiḥ || tatra gacchati kāmārtā yatra yenopalabhyate | mahācīnadrumarasenāktaṃ piṇḍaṃ vidhāya ca | yannāmnādīyate devi so'cirānmṛtyumṛcchati | mahācīnadrumalatāmajjābhirbilvapatrakaiḥ || sahasraṃ devīmabhyarcya śmaśāne sādhakottamaḥ || tadā rājyamavāpnoti yadi syāna palāyate | (yoṣinmūlamidaṃ rājyaṃ kulaṃ sarvatra śobhanam || tasyāpi ṣoḍaśāṃśena kalāṃ nārhantite'marāḥ | śavāsanādhikaphalaṃ latā gṛha praveśanam || evambhutaḥ sadā devi sādhako bhuvi durlabhaḥ | yayākayāti dṛṣyā vā yaḥ ko'pi bhuvi dṛśyate | etat prakāśanāddevi mṛtyurbhavati nānyathā || etat sādhakanindāṃ vā etanmantrasya vā punaḥ | mahābhūtaganaiḥ sārddhaṃ tasya sarvaṃ harāmyaham || yoginī cakra sahitaiḥ svayaṃ tadvadha kāriṇī | atha sārasvata prayogaḥ | taduktaṃ phetkārīye jihvāyāṃ nyasanādeva mūko'pi sukavirbhavet |
asyāyamarthaḥ | jihvāyāṃ vidyābuddhyā mukhe hastamāropya japediti kecit | bālasaṃskāra dīkṣākāle jihvāyāṃ likhanamiti kecit vastutastu tejorūpāṃ vidyāṃ jihvāyāṃ bhāvayediti nyasanarthaḥ | (rahasyārthaḥ) | taduktaṃ vīratantre jihvāyāṃ bhāvayedyastu tāriṇīṃ dīparūpinīm | vṛhaspati sama sthasya kavitā śukra nirjitā (nirmitā) || nīlatantre'pi brāhmao muhūrte utthāya kṛtvāvaśyaṃ susaṃyataḥ | jihvāyāṃ bhāvayan vidyāṃ tejorūpāṃ japet sudhīḥ || amṛta syāndinī tasya vāṇī sarvavidhā bhavat | ekavīrā kalpe (-) prātarvidyāṃ vibhāvyeva jihvāgre dīparūpiṇīm | mātṛkā sahitāṃ vidyāṃ ekāvṛttyā jalaṃ pibet || jalapāna vidhānena muko'pi sukavirbhavet | ajasra bhāvanābhyāsāt sādhakaḥ sukṛtī sudhīḥ | kavirvāgmī mahāyogī mukti bhāgī na saṃśayaḥ | tatrāyaṃ kramaḥ | dakṣahaste jalaganduṣamādāya jalābhiṣekena mātṛkāṃ japet | tatredaṃ japarahasyam | sabindūna svarān uccārya nirvindū (.. .. ..) ccāraṇavāyumavaṣṭabhya parabinduṃ prāpayya tatra sthitirūpeṇa ekavāraṃ japet | tato recakayogena tatha japtvā hastasthita gaṇḍuṣamānayet | tadanu tajjalaṃ pibediti rahasyārthaḥ | etad yogaṃ vatsarāvadhi kāryam | svatantratantre abdāccaturvidhaṃ tasya pāṇḍitya mupajāyate | atha rahasyāntaram | taduktaṃ vīratantre kulayuvati suyonau mantravarṇān vilikhya nikhila nigama mantrān supta dīṣādi duṣṭān | vidita gurukulāntavāhyavarṇā vidhiśo manu puṭita paṭiyān sādhayecchāntacetāḥ ||
kulapatha manusandhāyāmitāyāṃ svabhūmo tava janani jano ya stharpayet tīrthatoyaiḥ | arūṇa tarūṇa puṣpairgandha mālyānulepai racita surabhiveśaḥ taddhiyādhyāyate yaḥ || paricarati samastairnyāsa pūrveḥ prasiddhai stava parijanajālairyoginībhiḥ prapūjya | suvimala kulajātāṃ hrī ghṛṇā varjitāṃ yaḥ svayamapi vijitāṅgaḥ kṣobhakṛd yoginīnām | paśuripu kulacakraṃ saṃspṛśana madhyaśākhaṃ śuratarū suranāthaṃ śāpabhraṣṭo manuṣyaḥ | kulapathi kulanāthastadvayaṃ yojayitvā manu puṭita vimṛṣyaṃ (gyaṃ) yojayettadavahiryaḥ || janani tava kalānāṃ kovidāṃ kāmarūpaḥ kumati rahita cittaḥ saṃlikhet tāṃ tridhāre | vigata bhaya viṣādadhvānta jālaḥ sudhāṃśu stava caraṇalatānta niḥsaraddhūlijālaiḥ | parikalita vapusthadvatmabhirdevapūjyaiḥ | paricarati sa vijño mokṣapūjyādhipaḥ saḥ || atha mantrasiddhānukūla mahārahasyam | viśuddhesvara mahātantre śrīdevyuvāca | bhagavan prasīda deveśa sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ | yenāvaśyaṃ bhavet siddhirupāyaṃ vada śaṅkara || īśvara uvāca | śṛṇu devi paraṃ jñānaṃ sarvajñānottamottamam | yena vijñānamātreṇa kṣipraṃ vidyā prasīdati || mūlakande tu yā śakti bhujagākāra rūpinī | tadabhrāmārtavavāto'yaṃ prāṇa itu'cyate budhaiḥ || jhillīkāvyaktamadhurā kūjanti satatotthitā | gacchanti brahmarandhreṇa praviśanti suketane ||
yātāyāta kramainaiva tatra kuryānmanolayam | tena mantra śikṣā jātā (yātā) sarvasiddhi pradīpikā || tamaḥ pūrṇe gṛhe yadvannaḥ kiñcit pratibhāsate | śikhā hīnāstathā mantrā na siddhanti kadācana || śikhopadeśaḥ sarvatra gopitaḥ parameśvari | vināyena na siddhiḥ syādvarṣakoṭiśatairapi || tasmāt tvayāpi girije gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
atha rahasyāntaraṃ nīlatantre | suptā nidrāyitā mattā vidrāvaṇaratāḥ parā | samasta doṣa jālena grathitā kulasundarī || niśicāraṃ divācāraṃ sandhācārañca pallavam | darbhanaṃ bījasaṃyogaṃ bhāva saṃyogamevaca || jñātvā prabodhayedbījaṃ gururatraivakāraṇam | niśicāramityādi | niśicāraṃ vāmanāsāyāṃ vāyorudayaḥ | tathaiva dakṣiṇanāsāyāṃ vāyorudayaḥ divāvāraḥ | sandhācāraḥ ubhayanāḍī pravāhaḥ | taduktaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitāyāṃ svāpakāle tu mantrāṇāṃ japo na suphalapradaḥ | tatraivoktaṃ svāpakālo vāmavāhaḥ prabodho dakṣiṇāvahaḥ | āntreyasya manoḥ saumyamantrasyaitadviparyayaḥ || prabodha kālaṃ jāṇīyādubhavorūbhayorapi | karmaṇīrahitāva(-).viyataprāvāḥ samīritāḥ | āgneyyā manavaḥ saumyā bhūyiṣṭhendvamṛtāk'rāḥ || taduktaṃ svatantratantre tvadātmikā smṛtā vidyā mantrā devi(,) madātmikā | eva mantrā āgneyā vidyāḥ saumyāḥ | athanya rahasyam | śāntikādau yadi vāyo rviparītā syāttadā mantre hrasvadīrghayogaḥ kartavyaḥ |
vāmavāho yadā vāyu dīrghānāṃ yojanaṃ tadā | dakṣiṇasyāṃ yadā vāyustadā hrasvā niyojitā || ubhayasthau yadā vāyustadā syādubhayātmakaḥ | iti vijñāna bhaṭṭārakacaraṇāḥ | asyārthaḥ (-) yadā vidyādau dīrghayogaḥ tadā vāmavāhovāyuriti jānīyāt | tathaiva hrasvayogāt mantrānāmiti hrasvayogāt dakṣiṇavahaḥ | dīrghayogāt vāmavahaḥ | yadā mantravidyayohrasva dīrghayogastadā ubhayostao vāyuriti | pallavaḥ yatha svatantratantre ādau yogo bhavedante pallavaḥ sampuṭa dvayoḥ | ekāntaritaṃ prathanaṃ vidarbho dva'ntarīkṛtaḥ || asyārthaḥ | ādau yoga ityādinā ślokena mantreṣu sādhyakarmāṇi yojanā prakāramupadiśati | etaduktaṃ bhavati mantravidyayorādye sādhyasādhanakarmaṇāṃ yojane yogasaṃjñā | mantravidyayorante pūrvokta yojane pallava iti saṃjñā | mantravidyayorādyantayoḥ pūrvokta yojanāt sampūṭasaṃjñā || mantravidyayoḥ prāguktānāñca ekaikākṣarato'nyonya yojanāt grathana iti saṃjñā | mantravidyayoḥ prāgukānañca anyonyākṣaradvayayojanāt vidarbha iti saṃjñā | sa ca trividhaḥ | mantrākṣaradvayāntare sādhyākṣaramekaṃ yojayet ityekaprakāraḥ | sādhyakṣarāṇāṃ dvayāntare mantrādīnāmekamakṣaraṃ yojayodityaparaḥ | mantrādīnāmakṣaradvayorantare sādhyādīnāṃ akṣaradvayaṃ yojayedparaḥ | evaṃ trividhamiti subhagānandapādāḥ | bījasaṃyogo yathā | taduktaṃ vimalātantre praṇavo mātṛkādevī hṛllekhetyamṛtadvayam | amṛtatrayasaṃyogād duṣṭamantro'pi siddhyati || (bījasaṃyogantu mantrādau saptavāra saṃyogena japaḥ | tadanu yathātatheti bhāvasaṃyoga iti bhāvanirṇaye paṭale boddhavyam | etadrahasyācāraṃ puruṣaparam | yoṣitāṃ kulacūḍāmanau niyamaḥ puruṣe jñeyo na yoṣitsu kathañcana | yadvā tadvā yena kena sarvadā sarvato'pi ca ||
yoṣitāṃ dhyānayogena siddhayaḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ | yathāyaskāntamātreṇa gūḍhaviddhaḥ śiloccayaḥ || svayameva vahiryāti yathā vā sauratejasā | suryakāntaḥ sphuṭaṃ bhāti yathāvā cenduraśmibhiḥ || cantrakāntaṃ dravayati yathā varṣāsu vārivaiḥ | jalasekādabhitaptābhūrasampūrṇā pravakṣyate || kṣudhārtaḥ kṣīrapāṇena yathātṛpto'bhijāyate | kulapuṣpapradānena yathāśaktiḥ pratuṣyati || gurusevaikamātreṇa mantrasiddhiryathā bhavet | mahāpahyavanaṃ dhyātvā yathā yogīśvaro bhavet | tripurādhyānamātreṇa bhuktirmuktiryathā bhavet || mahādurgā prasādena yathā siddhiśvaro bhavet | gaṅgāsmaraṇamātreṇa niṣpāpo jāyate yathā || yathākarṣaṇamātreṇa śiva eva prajāyate | yoṣiccintanamātreṇa tatheyaṃ varadāyinī | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣapennijakaulikīm || (tathākulacūḍāmanau |) adīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ pade pade || [iti rahasya niṇa ye ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[atha saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
atha kumārī pūjā | jñānārṇave | hāmādikantu sakalaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ vinā | paripūrṇaphalaṃ naiva saphalaṃ pūjanādbhavet || evaṃ sakala siddha'rthaṃ suvāsinīṃ vā pūjayet | taduktaṃ pañcamakrame ānayet kanyakāṃ yobhyāṃ kumārīmbā suvāsinīm || jñānārṇave suvāsinī madaprauḍhā saṃśayaṃ tyaja pārvati || kumārīlakṣaṇaṃ rudrajāmale | kathayāmī na sandehaḥ kumāryāḥ pūjanaṃ śubham | tasyāḥ pūjana mātreṇa trailokya pūjanaṃ bhavet || kumārī tvaṃ ha'haṃ nātha stridhā mūrtirvyavasthitā | parā caivāparācaiva tṛtīyā ca parāparā || yatrakāle na kiñcit syāddevāsuramahoragāḥ | trailokyaṃ natvahaṃ tvañca tadājātā kumārikā || ādyā sṛṣṭikari yātupratyakṣā sātutattridhā | umā kalā tu sā jātā sṛṣṭirūpā bhavāryāve ||
ekavarṣā bhavet sandhā dvivarṣātu sarasvatī | trivarṣātu stridhā mūrtiścaturvaṣātu kālikā || subhagā pañcavarṣātu ṣaḍvarṣātu umā bhavet | saptamī mālinī sākṣāt aṣṭavarṣātu kubjikā || navabhiḥ kālasaṅkarṣā daśabhiścāparājitā || ekādaśe tu rudrāṇī dvādaśābde tu bhairavī || trayodaśe mahālakṣmīḥ dvisaptāḥ pīṭhanāyikāḥ || kṣetrajñāḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ oṃsḍaśe carcikā matā | evaṃ krameṇa pūjyet yāvat puṣpaṃ na vidyate || pratipadādipūrṇāntaṃ vṛddibhedena pūjayet | mahāparvaṣu tā devīrviśeṣācca pavitrake || mahānavamyāṃ deveśi kumārīśca prapūjayet || piṅgalāṃ pūjayed yastu ṣoḍaśaiścaiva bhaktimān | bhaktitaḥ pūjayitvā tu sarvasampattimān bhavet || pūjayet kulavidyānāmekāmbā kulabharavi (vaḥ) || evaṃ praṇavayogena caitanyatanumarcayet | ai(/) hri(/) śrī(/) hrī hū(/) ete pañcapraṇavāśca | (tathā rudra) jāmale vāṇī māyā tathā lakṣmīrmāyākūrccadvayaṃ tataḥ | ete ca praṇavā jñeyāḥ kumāryāḥ paripūjane || caturddaśasvareṇāḍheyo bhṛguvindvendu saṃyutaḥ | caitanya bījakathitaṃ sādhakānāṃ samṛddhidam || hesau(/) caitanyabījaṃsyādubhau bījākṣarau śiva | evaṃ dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaiva saptāṣṭanavadhā punaḥ ||
nityakrameṇa deveśi pūjayedvidhipūrvakam | ghnanti vighnān pūjitāstāstathā śatrūn mahotkaṭān | vyādhayaḥ sarvariṣṭāni durnimittāni saṃśayam | grahā yakṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti bhūta vetāla pannagāḥ || asurā guha'kāḥpretāḥ yoginī guha'ḍākinī | mahābhayāni durbhikṣādhyutpātāni kuleśvara || duḥsvapnamapamṛtyuñca anye ye ye samudbhavāḥ | kumārīpūjanādeva na tasya prabhavanti hi || animādīni siddhāni pātālaguṭikāñcanam (nāḥ) | pratyakṣaṃ divyavetālo bhavet kumārikārcaṇāt || ai(/) ṅkāreṇa jalaṃdeyaṃ hrī ukāre pāda śodhanam | śrīṅkāreṇārghakaṃ dadyāt kūrcabījena candanam || śaktibījena puṣpāni ṣaṣṭhe dhūpañca dāpayet | ai(/) hrī(/) śrī(/) hrau(/) he(/) kulakumārike hṛdayāy namaḥ | hai(/) vai(/) hra(/) śrī(/) hrī(/) aiṃ svāhā śirase svāhā | a(/) hri(/) se(/) śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | ai(/) kula kulavāgīśvara vāgīśvari kavacāya hu(/) | hrī(/) astrāya phaṭ | ai(/) siddhajayāya pūrvavakrāya namaḥ | a(/) ai(/) jayāya uttaravakrāya namaḥ | ai(/) hrī(/) śrī(/) kubjike paścima vakrāya namaḥ | ai(/) kālike dakṣiṇavakrāya namaḥ |
vāgbhavena rupu kṣobhaṃ māyābīje guṇāṣṭakam | śriyo bīje śriyolābhaḥ hrī(/) bīje cārisaṃkṣayaḥ || bhairavena tu bījena khagatvamamarādibhiḥ | kumārikā ha'haṃ nātha sadā tvañca kumārikā || aṣṭottara śataṃ vāpi ekāṃ kanyāṃ prapūjayet | pūjitāḥ pratipūjyante nirddahanta'vamānitāḥ || kumārī yoginī sākṣāt kumārī sarvadevatā | bhūrbhuvo mūrtipādaikā kumārītrikapūjitāḥ || āsurā duṣṭanāgāśca ete duṣṭagrahā api | bhūta vetālagandharvā ḍākinī yakṣarākṣasāḥ || hṛdayaṃ devatāḥ sarvā bhūrbhuvasvaśca bhairavāḥ | pṛthivyādīni sarvāni brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | te tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yantu kanyāṃ prapūjayet || kālāgniśivaparyantaṃ tathā gauryādi saṃsthitaḥ | saptadvīpā samudrāśca bhuvanāni caturdaśa || vidhiyuktaṃ kumārīcca bhojayeccaika bhairavīm | pādyamadhyaṃ tathādhūpaṃ kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ śubham || bhaktibhāvena saṃpūjya sarvaṃ tasyai nivedayet | pradakṣiṇa trayaṃ kuryāt ādimadhye tathāntataḥ || paścācca dakṣiṇā deyā rajata svarṇa mauktikaiḥ | vivāhayet svayaṃ kanyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vinaśyati || gohatyāñcaiva strīhatyāṃ sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati | mātaraḥ pitaraścaiva bhrātaraścaiva sarvataḥ || ye tu yatra punaḥ sarve kanyādānaṃ prakalpayet | bhukti mukti phalantrasya saubhāgyaṃ sarvasampadaḥ ||
rudraloke vasennityaṃ trinetro bhagavān haraḥ | ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāni aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || etat phalaṃ labhenmūrtaḥ kanyāṃ yastu vivāhayet | bālukā sāgare yāvat tāvadabdaṃ nareśvaraḥ || ekaikaṃ kulamuddhṛtya svargakalpe gato'pi ca | tāvadbhuñjanti te bhogān yāvadbhūmi divaukasaḥ | kanyādānaṃ mahādānaṃ sarvadāneṣu cottamam | daurbhāgyaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ saubhāgyañca pravartate || rājadvāre labhet pūjāṃ rājamānyaḥ svayaṃ naraḥ | sarveṣāñca kumārīñca pūjayecca prayatnataḥ || mahābhaye samutpanne kranyakāñcaiva pūjayet | tatkṣaṇāt labhate mokṣaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ tu bhairava ||
