athedānīṃ rahasyātirahasya puraścaraṇaṃ likhyate |
tathā ca gāndharve devyuvāca | mahācīnakramaṃ deva sūcitaṃ na prakāśitam | kathayasva mahādeva sarva siddhipradaṃ mahat | bhairava uvāca | sarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt sarvadeva namaskṛtam | sarva pāpa haraṃ devi sarvaroga vināśanam || brahmāviṣṇumaheśānāṃ dikpālānāñca bhāvini | bhairavānāñca sarveṣāṃ gandharvānāñca yoginām || sukhasiddhipradaṃ devi sarveṣāmālayaṃ mahat | sarvapāpaharaṃ devi vīrasādhanamūrjitam || mahābalau mahābuddhirmahā sāhasikaḥ śuciḥ | mahāsvaccho davāvāṃśca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ | teṣāṃ kṛte maheśāni kathitaṃ vīrasādhanam || aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi | kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa sādhayedanayāhitam || bhaumavāre tamiśrāyāṃ yāme yāte ca bhāvini | tadarddhamyantare samyak pūjopakaraṇaṃ balim || sāmiṣānnaṃ guḍaṃ chāgaṃ surāpiṣṭaka pāyasam || nānāphalañca naivedyaṃ svasva kalpokta sādhitam ||
citāsthānaṃ samānīya suhṛdbhiḥ śasnapānibhiḥ | samāna guṇa sampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam || citālakṣaṇaṃ yathā | asaṃskṛtā citā grāhā natu saṃskārasaṃyutā | caṇḍālādiṣu saṃprāpya kevalaṃ śīghrasiddhidā || vīratante'pi | śavamvāpi citāmvāpi nītvā gatvā yathāsukham | snātvā baddhvā surakṣāṃ vai devatādhyānatat paraḥ || bhītaścet sādhakastatra caturdiśiva sādhakāḥ | māmaimībhairiti vākyai vīrāyanti punaḥ punaḥ || nacet svayaṃ kevalo'sau bhairavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | vastrālaṅkārabhūṣādyairbhūṣitaḥ pūrvasammukhaḥ || astrāntumūlamantreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu | gurupādarajo dhyātvā gaṇeśaṃ vaṭukaṃ tathā || yoginīṃ mātṛkāñcaiva vāmapādapuraḥsaram | ye cātra saṃsthitā devā rākṣasāśca bhayānakāḥ || piśācāḥ siddhayakṣāśca gandharvāśca khacarāstriyaḥ || siddhidāste bhavantṛtra tathā ca mamarakṣakāḥ || pranamya manunānena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet | śmaśānādhipatiṃ paścād bhairavaṃ kālabhairavam || mahākālaṃ yajed yatnāt pūrvādi dikcatuṣṭaye | pādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayet | śabdabījaṃ tataḥ paścāt śmaśānādhipatat param ||
imamante sāmiṣānnaṃ baliṃgṛhna tataḥ param | gṛhnāpaya padadvandvaṃ vighnānivāraṇaṃ tataḥ || kurusiddhiṃ me tataśca prayaccha svāhayā yutam | praṇavādyena manunā prathamo balirīritaḥ || māyānte bhairavāt paścāt bhayānaka tataḥ param | pūrvavanmanumuddhṛtya dakṣiṇe balimāharet || hū(/)mante ca mahākālāt paścāt pūrvavaduddharet | paścime kāladevāya praṇavādyena dāpayet || śabdānte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti tataḥ param | śmaśānādhipa ityevaṃ pūrvavaccauttare haret || citāmadhye tato dadyād balitrayamanuttamam | kālarātri mahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvane || gṛhānemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi siddhimanuttamām | kālikāyai baliṃ datvā bhūtanāthāya dāpayet || śabdānte bhūtanāthāya śmaśānādhipa ityapi | praṇavādyena manunā dāpayed balimuttamam || hū(/) śabdānte sarvagaṇa nāthānte cādhipāya ca | śmaśānamastake datvā pūrvavacca samuddharet || tārādyena baliṃ datvā pañcagavyena sundari | asthisaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhamantraṃ likhettataḥ || bhūrjaṃ vā vaṭapatre vā tatra pīṭhemanuṃ nyaset || pīṭhamāstīrya tasmin vai baddhavīrāsanastataḥ | vīrārddhenena deveśi rakṣaṃ dikṣprakalpayet || kūrcabījadvayaṃ devi māyāyugmādanantaram | kālike ghoradaṃṣṭre ca pracaṇḍe caṇḍa nāyike ||
dānavān dāraypyuktvā hanetidvitayaṃ tataḥ | śavaśarīra mahāvighnaṃ chedaya dvitayaṃ tataḥ || dviṭhāntaṃ varmaśastrānto vīrārddhanamanurmataḥ || anena mantritaṃ loṣṭraṃ daśadikṣu samāstaret | tanmadhye bhairavo devī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate || yadi pramādād deveśi sādhako bhayavihvalaḥ | tatra taistai suhṛdvargaṃ rarkṣito nābhibhūyate || arkendasita vāṭyālatulai (sūtra)rnirmita vartikā | pradīpaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya astraṃ tatra prapūjayet || hate tasmin mahādīpe vighnaiśca paribhūyate | tadadhaścāstramantrena likhet kulapradīpikām || tattat kalpokta vidhinā bhūtaśuddhā'dikaṃ caret | mātṛkākṣarasaṃyuktāṃ vidyāṃ ṣaḍddha nyaset tataḥ || vu'tkrama kramayogena tārā ṣoḍhā prakīrtitā | ṣoḍhāvinyastadehastu sākṣādviśveśvaro bhavet | ṣoḍhāṃ vā tārakamvāpi vinyasya pūjayettataḥ | mantradhyāna parābhūtvā japenmantramananya dhīḥ || ekākṣaro yadi bhavet diksahasraṃ tato japet | dvakṣyare cāṣṭasāhasraṃ'tra'kṣare tvayutārddhakam || tataḥ parantu mantrajño gajārddhaka sahasrakam || athavā (-) niśāyāṃ japamārabhya udayāntaṃ samācaret | japādau tu baliṃ datvā paścādapi baliṃ haret || japānte japamadhye vā dehi dehīti bhāṣite | tadāpi ca baliṃ dadyād mahiṣamvāpi chāgalam ||
na dikṣu vīkṣaṇaṃ kiñcinna ca bandhu samāgamaḥ | jalādidurgasarpāgni gajānāṃ daṃṣṭrināṃ tathā || pakṣikīṭa piśācānāṃ yadyanmanasi saṃsthitam | tatsarvaṃ svapnabadvuddhā'bhayaṃ sarvatra varjayet || samāpya sādhanaṃ devi dakṣiṇāṃ vibhavāvadhi | guruve gurupatrāya tatpatnyaivā pradāpayet || samyak siddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacit | vahumantravataḥ puṃsaḥ kā kathā śiva eva saḥ || yataḥ sarvatra deveśi gurupūjā garīyasī | tadagre mantratantrānāṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ naiva kārayet || pūjite gurupāde vai sarvadevaḥ sukhī bhavet | sarveṣāṃ mantratantrānāṃ pitāsauyat sadāśivaḥ || anyadeva saparyāṃ vā anyadevasya kīrtanam | guru devaṃ vinā devi tadagre narakaṃ vrajet || śavārūḍho yadi bhavet tadviśeṣa ihocyate | śūṣyāgāre vilvamūle nadītīre catuṣpathe || śmaśāne vā viśeṣeṇa nītvā uddhṛtya bhūṣayet | ānīya sthāpayedādau nyāsajālaṃ samācaret | pīṭhamantraṃ samālikhya gandhapuṣpādibhistataḥ || abhyarca'cāsanaṃ datvā rakṣāmātmani kārayet | tataḥ śavāsye vidhivaddevatāpyāyanaṃ tataḥ || tato japtvā sarvamantraṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | tāraṃ śabdaṃ mṛtakāya namo'ntaṃ mantramuccaret || śavasvapanamantro'yaṃ śavāsanamanuṃ tataḥ | mantrānte bhuvaneśīsyāt phaḍantā mantra īrita || mahānīlakramaṃ devi sarvasiddhipradāyakam | na kasyacit pravaktavyaṃ goptavyaṃ prītaye mama | sarvaṣāṃ jīvahīnānāṃ jantūnāṃ vīrasādhane | brāhmaṇaṃ gomayaṃ tyaktvā sādhayedvīra sādhanam ||
mahāśavāḥ praśastāḥ suḥ pradhāna sādhanaṃ priye | brāhmaṇantu striyaṃ tyaktvā sādhayedvīra sādhanam || kṣūdrāḥ prayogakartṝṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddhaye | śmaśāne tu puraścaryā kathitā devi durlabhā || atha bhairavatantre'pi yaduktaṃ bhāvasarvasve sarvatantreṣu gopitam | vīrasiddhi vidhānantu devadevena śambhunā || yasya vijñānamātrena mandabhāgyo'pi sidhyati | ahorātreṇa kālena helayā sādhakottamaḥ || mantraṃ nītvā guroḥ pārśvaṃ gurubhakti parāyaṇaḥ | mantraśrotrāsyanayana prāṇān vijñāya yatnataḥ || mantrañca kīlakaṃ jñātvā kuryānmantrapuraskriyām | pūraśraraṇa sampanno vīrasiddhiṃ samācaret || taduktaṃ svacchanda bhairave'pi samyak pariśrameṇāpi naivasiddhiḥ samīhitā | jāyate tatra kartavyaṃ sādhakai vīrasādhanam || pūtradāradhanasneha lobha mohavivarjitaḥ | mantraṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmi dehambā pātayāmyaham || pratijñāmīdṛśīṃ kṛtvā balidravyāni cintayet | yasyamantrasya yaddravyaṃ tattad grāha'ñca sādhakaiḥ || śavalakṣaṇaṃ yathā | sarveṣāṃ jīvahīnānāṃ jantunāṃ vīrasādhane | brahmaṇaṃ gośavaṃ tyaktvā sādhayedvīrasādhanam || mahāśavāḥ praśastāḥ suḥ pradhāne vīrasādhane | brāhmaṇantu striyaṃ tyaktvā sādhayedvīrasādhanam || tataḥ prayogakartṝṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddhaye | ūrddhaṃ dvivarṣād yadi vā pañca vā taruṇaṃ yadi ||
saptamāṣṭamamāsīyaṃ garbhajaṃ yadivā śavam | cāṇḍālaṃ cābhibhūtambā śīghrasiddhiphalapradam || iti kṣetraṃ ḍāmare ā bhairavatantre'pi yaṣṭiprabhṛtibhirviddhaṃ cābhibhūtaṃ jalemṛtam | (śavamānīya kartavyaṃ nāharet svecchayā mṛtam || strīvaśya patitāspṛśya nayavarjaṃ hitaṃ navam | avyakta liṅgaṃ kuṣṭhimvā viprabhinnaṃ śavaṃ haret || na durbhikṣamṛtaṃ vṛddaṃ na paryuṣitameva vā | strījanañcedvaśaṃ rūpaṃ sarvathā parivarjayet || iti śavalakṣaṇam | athasthāna nirnayo bhairavatantre | śuṇyāgāre vilyamūle nadītīre catuṣpathe || śmaśāne vā viśeṣeṇa nītvā coddhṛtya bhūṣayet | anyatrāpi | śuṇyāgāramaraṣyambā nītvodvarta vibhūṣayet || saṃsthāpya kuśa śayyāyāṃ puruṣaṃ divyarūpiṇam | taduktaṃ ekavīrā kalpe ānīya snāpayedādau nyāsajālaṃ samācayet | pīṭhamantraṃ samālikhya gandhapuṣpādirbhastataḥ || abhyarca'cāsanaṃ datvā rakṣāmatmani kārayet | tataḥ śavāsye vidhivaddevatāpyāyanaṃ tataḥ || tato japtvā sarvamantraṃ sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet | tāraṃ śabdaṃ mṛtakāyanamo'nte mantramuccaret || śavasnapanamantro'yaṃ śavāsanamanuṃ tataḥ | tārānte bhuvaneśī syāt phaḍanto mantra īritaḥ || matsya sūkte'pi tataḥ śavaṃ kṣālayitvā snāpayecca prayatnataḥ | yadi raktāktakastiṣṭhed bhairavācca bhayaṃ bhavet || elālavaṅga karpūrajātī khadira sārdrakaiḥ | tāmbulañca mukhe kṣiptvā śavaṃ kuryādadho mukham || snāpayitvā ca tatpṛṣṭhe candanena vilepayet | vāgumūlānta kaṭaṇtaṃ caturasraṃ vidhāya ca ||
madhye padmaṃ caturdvāraṃ dalāṣṭaka samanvitam | tataścaileyamājinaṃ kambalāntaritaṃ nyaset || pūjādravyaṃ sannidhauca dūre cottarasādhakam | saṃsthāpya śavamabhyarca'tatrāśvārohanaṃ viśet || kuśān pādatale datvā śakeśān prasārya ca | dṛḍhaṃ nivaddha'juṭikāṃ tañca devasvarūpiṇam || tasyāṃ devaṃ susaṃpūjya paṭheduthyāya sammukhe | madvaśe bhava deveśa vīrasiddhikṛtāspade | paṭṭasūtrasya rajjukena caraṇau bandhayeddṛḍham || a(/) bhīma bhīru bhayābhāva bhāvya locana bhāvuka | trāhi māṃ devadeśa śavānāmadhipādhipa || iti pādatale tasya trikonaṃ yantramullikhet | tenotthātuṃ na śaknoti śavastu niścalo bhavet || upviśya punastatra bāhu niḥsārya pādayoḥ | hastayoḥ kuśamāstīrya pādau tatra nidhāpayet || ttaṣṭhau tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥ | sadā devaṃ (vīṃ) hṛdidhyātvā maunī japamathācaret || calāsanādbhayaṃ nāsti bhayejāte vadettataḥ | yatprārthaya balitvena dātavyaṃ kuñjarādikam || dināntare rudvasyāmi svanāma kathayasva me | ityuktvā saṃskṛtoktā ca nirbhayastu punarjapet || tataścenmadhurai vakti vaktavyaṃ līlayā naraiḥ|| (na vai) || tataḥ satyaṃ kārayitvā varaṃ tatprārthayennaraḥ | yadi satyaṃ na karoti varaṃ vā na prayacchati ||
tadā punarjapeddhīmān ekāgra yatamānasaḥ | satye kṛte varaṃ labdhā saṃ tyajettu japādikam || phalaṃ jātamiti jñātvā juṭikāṃ mocayettadā | śavaṃ prakṣālya saṃsthāpya mocayet pādavandanam || pādacakraṃ mocayitvā pūjādravyaṃ jale kṣipet | śavaṃ jale'pa garte vā niḥkṣipya snānamācaret || tatastu svagṛhaṃ gatvā baliṃ dadyāddināntare | agnimarātrau yena yācito'haṃ baliṃ priyam | tena gṛhnantu mayādattāmimaṃ balim || atha ye yāṃṣitānaśvān narakuñjara śūkarān | datvā piṣṭamayān tena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam || parehni nityamācarya pañcagavyaṃ pibettataḥ | brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyakān || sapta pañca vihīnān vā kramenaiva daśāvadhi | tataḥ snātvā tu bhuktvā ca viseduttameṃ sthale || yadi na syād viprajyojyaṃ tadā nirddhanatāṃ vrajet | tena cennirdhanatvaṃ syādumā devī prakupyati || trirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍarā e navarātrantu gopayet | strīśayyāṃ yadi gacchedvai tadāvyādhiṃ vinirdiśet || gīta śrutvāpi vadhiro niśrakṣurnṛtyadarśanāt | yadi vakti dine vākyaṃ tadāsya mūkatā bhavet || pañcadaśadinaṃ yāvat dehe devasya saṃsthitiḥ || na svīkuryād gandhapuṣpaṃ bahiryāti yadā yadā | tadā vastraṃ parityajya gṛhnīyādvasanāntaram ||
go brāhmaṇa vinindāñca na ca kuryāt kadācana | durjanaṃ patitādīṃśca na spṛśecca kadācana | deva gobrāhmaṇādīṃśc pratyahaṃ saṃspṛśecchuciḥ | prāyarnitya kriyānte ca vilvapatrodakaṃ pibet || tataḥ snātvā tu gaṅgāyāṃ prāpte ṣoḍaśavāsare | svāhāntaṃ mantramuccarya tarpanānte namaḥ padam || evaṃ śatatrayādūrddhaṃ devānvai tarpayejjalaiḥ| snānatarpaṇa śuṇyasya na syāddevasya tarpanam | ityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti niścitam || iha bhuktvā varān bhogānantethāti paraṃ padam | iti vīrasādhanam | athavānya prakāreṇa puraścaraṇa miṣyate | kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtam || pañcagavya samāliptaṃ candanādyairviśeṣataḥ | niḥkṣipya bhūmau hastārddhamānataḥ kānane ghane || tatra taddivase rātrau sahasraṃ yadi sādhakaḥ | ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sabhavet kalpapādapaḥ || athavā śavamānīya tenaiva parikhanya ca | taddināt taddinaṃ yāvat tāvadaṣṭottaraṃsatam || sabhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | athavā | aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayobhayorapi || sūryodayāt samārabhya yāvat sūryodayāntaram | tāvajjaptvā nirataṅkaḥ sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet ||
athavā | candrasūryagrahe caiva śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ | nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ || grahaṇādi vimokṣāntaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ | anantaraṃ daśāṃśena kramāddhomādikañcaret || evaṃ kṛte siddhamantraḥ prayogānapi sādhayet | sūryagrahaṇa kālāddhi nānyaḥ kālaḥ praśasyate || atra yadyatkṛtaṃ sarvamananta phaladaṃ bhavet | athavā śarat kāle caturthyādi navamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ || bhaktitaḥ pūjayitvā tu rātrau tāvat sahasrakam | aṣṭamyādi navamyantamupavāsaparo bhavet | anyatra gurumārgasya laṅghanaṃ naiva kārayet || athavā aṣṭamī sandivelāyā maṣṭottaralatāgṛham | praviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarca'yatnataḥ || pūrvokta kalpamāsādya prajādakamathācaret | kevalaṃ kāmadevo'sau japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || tāsāñca patramūle tu ulkā saṃgṛha'mastake | mahāsiddhirbhavet sadyo latādarśana pūjanāt || athavā kuntākṛṣti latāgātre likhitvā mantramuttamam | saṃpūjya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedayet || kiñcijjaptaṃ manuṃ nītvā devatā bhāva tata paraḥ | tāṃ prapūjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā susaṃyataḥ || prātaḥ strībhyo baliṃ datvā mantrāsiddhirṇa saṃśayaḥ | athavā bhūmiputra samāyuktā amāvasyā śubhapradā || bhādre puṃ ṛkṣayogena tasyāṃ vīravarottamaḥ | viṣṇukāntāṃ samānīya niḥkṣipenmṛtabhūmiṣu ||
tatra tāṃ sādhitāṃ kṛtvā taddine mṛtahaṭṭake | tatra prasāritaṃ matsyamekamūlyena dāpayet || tajjalenābhiṣekastu pūrvacca śavopari | sādhitāṃ vijayāṃ tasya udare mukhvartmanā | kṣiptvā tatraiva tanmatsyamañjanāñcitalocanaḥ | tilakī pūrvatravyeṇa utthāya ca manuṃ japet || svayamāyāti bhagavāna laṇḍāḍāṅkita bhairavaḥ | caratītastuto vīrastaṃ vilokya japenmanum || yadi bhāgyavaśāddevi laṇḍaḍastatra labhyate | tadā svayaṃ bhairavo'sau svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavet || athavā matsya mānīyadeveśi niḥkṣipya pitṛkānane | tadā sakṛjjapitvā ca devatā melanaṃ bhavet || athavā niśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabharavaḥ | digvāsā vimalī bhasmabhūṣaṇo mukta keśakaḥ || kapālī khaḍgahastaśca jepenmātṛkayā yadi | tadātasya mahādevi sarvasiddhiḥ karesthitā || ḍākinīṃ yoginīmmāpi anyāṃ vā bhūtalāṅganām | tatra cānīya sampūjya sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet || athavā gurumānīya saṃsthāpya devavata pūjayed vibhum | vastrālaṅkāra hemādyaiḥ svayaṃ santoṣya sadgurum || tatsutaṃ tatsutāñcaiva patnīñcaiva viśeṣataḥ | pūjayitvā manuṃ japtvā sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet || athavā sahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prapūjya ca | kevalaṃ devabhāvena japtvā siddhiśvaro bhavet || gurudhyānaṃ yathā (nīlatantre) sahasradale paṅkaje vimala śītaraśmiprabhaṃ | varābhaya karāmbujaṃ vimala gandhapuṣpāmbaram || prasanna vadanekṣaṇaṃ sakaladevatārupiṇam | smarechirasi haṃsagaṃ tadabhidhānapūrvaṃ gurum ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathā vibhavavistaraiḥ | guro ranujñāmātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati || guruṃ vilaṅghaśāstre'smin nādhikāraḥ surairapi | evañca mantratantrāṇāṃ prayogaḥ kriyate yadi || guruvaktraṃ vinā devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyate || etat tantrañca mantrañca śiṣyebhyo'pi na darśayet | anyathā pretarājasya bhavanaṃ yāti niścitam || atha puraścaraṇa vyatirekeṇa mantrasiddhi prakāro likhyate | taduktaṃ vīratantre devyuvāca ||
śambho sarvavicāravaryacaturaḥ sarvāṃgamānāṃ nidhi stvaṃ vedaḥ sadasatphaika nipunaḥ stvaṃ brahmavedyo navā | devo'jaḥ sṛṣṭipāre prabhavati khaluyuṣmādṛśaḥ kāryarūpaṃ tannaivāsti na jāyate mamapunarvācyaṃ vicāryantaro || yaduktaṃ bhavatā tantraṃ tat sarva duḥkhasiddhidam | vinā duḥkhairvinā pāpaistatsiddhiṃ vruhi satvaram || bhagavān uvāca | vinā duḥkhairvinā pāpairvinā puraskriyādibhiḥ | siddhimantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || yenānuṣṭhita mātreṇa bhogena mokṣamāpnuyāt | na vaktramucitaṃ loke tava snehādihocyate || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi gurusiddhiparaḥsaram | gopitaṃ koṭitantreṣu īdānīṃ prakaṭīkṛtam || rahasyaṃ mantrasiddhestu puraścaryādikaṃ vinā | etat prakāśanālloke mahāhāniḥ pade pade || śivaśikhi sitabhānuṃ pañcamānta'svarāḍhyaṃ dvitayamidamapūrvaṃ bījamugrapramāyāḥ | kṣaṇamapi khamanīnāṃ maṇḍalāntarvibhāvya kṣapayati duradṛṣṭaṃ vādirāḍ jāyatesaḥ || 1 ||
sa jayati ripuvargān vādirājo vivāde ramayati ramaṇīnā cittacauraḥ sthirāyuḥ | kavayati kavirājairapyadṛṣṭaṃ sukāvyaṃ madhumatirapi heyāḥ kiṃ punaḥ siddhisaṃghāḥ ||2|| kulayuvatiṣu yonau mantravarṇān vilikhya nikhilanigama mantrān supta doṣādiduṣṭāna | vidita gurukulāntarvāha'vartmāvidhijño manupuṭita paṭiyān sādhayet śāntacetāḥ ||3|| kulapatha manusandhāyāmitāyāṃ svabhūmau tava janani janīyastarpayet tīrthaḥ toyaiḥ | aruṇatara supuṣpairgandhamālyānulepai racitayuvativeśaṃ (śaḥ) taddhiyā dhyāyate saḥ ||4|| paricarati samastairnyāsapūrvaiḥ (jālaiḥ) prasiddhai stava parijanajālairyonicakre prapūjya | suvimalakulajātāṃ hrī ghṛṇāvarjitāṃ yaḥ svayamapi vijitāṅgaḥ kṣohakṛd yoginīnām ||5|| paśuripukulacakraṃ saṃspṛśan madhyaśākhaṃ surataru suranāthaḥ śāpabhraṣṭo manuṣyaḥ | kulapathi kulanāthastaddayaṃ yojayitvā manupuṭita vimṛśyaṃ yojayet tadvahiryaḥ ||6|| janani tava kalānāṃ kovidāṃ kāmarūpaḥ kumati rahita cittaḥ saṃlikhet tāṃ tridhāre | vigata bhaya viṣādadhvāntajālaḥ sudhāṃśu stava caraṇatalāntarniḥsaraddhuli jālaiḥ ||7|| parikalita vapustadvartmabhirdevapūjyaiḥ paricarati sa vijño mokṣacaryādhipaḥ saḥ |
madanamada badhūnāṃ bījamuddhṛtya śaktiṃ tadanu kaṭhina bījaṃ lokadhātrīṃ tadantaḥ ||8|| yadi japati tvadantarbhāva māsadhye sadyaḥ suranagaragataistaiḥsiddhighṛndaiḥ sa pūjyaḥ | śivabhṛgu mada pṛthvī śaktiyuktaṃ susiddhaṃ harihara caturāsya svasvabhūti prasūtam ||9|| parama rasa rasajñaḥ kṣobhakṛt kāminīnāṃ adhipatirapi vācāṃ śrīpatiḥ sārvabhaumaḥ | mṛgumada kaṭhinādhaḥ kāmabījaṃ tadagre bhuvanabhaya vināśa kṣobhinīṃ yojayitvā ||10|| yadijapati sakṛdvā cintayed vīrasiṃhaḥ kulayuvatikulāntaḥ kṣobhakṛt kāmarūpāt | mada varuṇatalādhaḥ śaktibījaṃ niyojya smahara harirūpī kāmarūpaḥ kuveraḥ ||11|| ripukula hariṇākṣī locanāmbhoja vipruṭa vipulajala niṣekāt khaṇḍitāntotyatāpaḥ | śivabhṛgu bhṛgumūlaṃ lobhamūlaṃ samūlaṃ bhajati yadigūrūṇāṃ vartmamūlaṃ vimṛṣya ||12|| nidhipatirapi nātho gīṣpatiḥ kṣudracetāḥ | yadi bhavati tadetanmukhya murvaupatitvam || varuṇa raṇa vivarjaṃ'ghrāṇamekaṃ vivarjaṃ tadupari mṛgacihnaṃ dvandvametadbhavānyāḥ ||13|| nikhilamanuvarāṇāṃ mokṣadānaikadatraḥ sadasada samadharmākṣemakṛnmantrarājaḥ | analaśirasi dharmaṃ rādivarjaṃsacandraṃ bhavasamanayayuktaṃ bījametdbhavānyāḥ ||14|| tritayamaparimāṇaṃ vaktumīśo maheśaḥ kimiha kamalajanmā janmadhārāsahasraiḥ | iha bhajati ya enaṃ mantrarājaṃ subhāgyai bhavati janani yuṣamt pādapadmopabhaktā ||15||
tyājasi parapramāṃsaṃ mādṛśaṃ kvāpikāle na khalu vapuranrghyaṃ tasya kācit kadācit | vihita gurumukhādvā vālakādvā paśorvā likhitamapi suvuddhā prāpya kasmādakasmāt ||13|| smararipu purapāre mokṣapūryāśca pāre parama pada vilīnaḥ sarvasaubhāgyabhogaiḥ | analapuravibhāge kālikārandhrabījaṃ tadapi yadi vidadhyāddigayutaṃ dantavarnam ||17|| nayanayutalakāraṃ mastake nāmayuktam tadanu vikaṭadaṃṣṭrāsotkaṭaṃ bījamuktam | yadi japati samastaṃ guha'guhaṃ ātiguhaṃ trijagati kimihāsti kleśalabhyaṃ kathañcit ||18|| krama paṭhitamapūrvaṃ sarvamevānurūndhaṃ manumaparamavācyaṃ sarvamadhyastharūpam | bhajati yadicidānandarūpo naro'sau ||19|| iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasya paramādbhūtam | yathānukramatāloke kiṃ na sādhayati yogirāṭ ||20||
athaiṣāṃ ṭīkā || atha mahācīnakramāṇāṃ satpuruṣāṇāṃ aṣṭādaśa padyena pajjhṭikayā teṣāmācāraḥ ucyate | samastatantraṃ śrutvā nirvṛtimanākalayya snativyājena jijñāsituṃ bhagavatītyāha śambho sarvavicāre ityādi | he śambho sarvavicāreṣu pradhānaḥ caturaḥ samarthaḥ | yaḥ sarvatra caturaḥ sa kimāgamajñaḥ ityāha sarvāgamānāṃ nidhiriti | bhavatyāhaṃ kathaṃ jñāta ityādi veda iti nitya iti jñāyate | nahi phaladātā ityāha sadasatphalaikanipuna iti śāstā iti yāvat | śāstāsta śambhu stat kimityāha brahmavedyaḥ | bhavadvarṇanīt karṣādikalṃ brahmagā jñāyate navā | ataeva sarvotakṛṣṭatvaṃ ahamanujāne | tatkati na santi | na tava manorathaṃ varṇayituṃ śakyā iti bhagavad dvipāre yadasti tannaivāsti | śaśaśṛṅganyāyenālīkatyāt | yadyapi jānāmi tathāpi asmat stutyā'laṃ ato nahi kartā ityāha asmādṛśo yato na jāyate kāryarūpaṃ tvayā anukriyate | dharmigrāhākapramāṇena bhagavataḥ sṛṣṭisthiti saṃhāra kartṛtvāt | atatravāha sādhāraṇaguro mama vacanīyaṃ vicāryājñāṃ vidhehi | nanu stutyā kimiti cet(,) guruṃ praṇamya jijñāsā kāryā vai nānyathā budhaiḥ | guruṇāpi tathāvidha bhaktiyuktāya śiṣyāy kathitavyam | tathāca vīratantre śiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya śāntāyaiva prakāśayediti śravaṇāt | nanu sarvatantraṃ tvayi prakāśita mato jijñāsāvasara ityāha yaduktamiti | he bhagavan yaduktaṃ tat tathaiva sādhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinā yathā nirvahati tathā kriyatām nanu bagutara duḥkhaṃ vinā paradārādisukhaṃ vidyate ityāśaṅkyāha vinā pāpairiti | tacca bahuladveṣaviṣayam || avasarasaṅgatyā maheśenocyate vināduḥkhairiti ślokārthaḥ sphuṭa eva | sādhakānāṃ śraddhābhijñānārthaṃ prarocayati | yataḥ prarocanā pravṛttavupayujyate | pravṛtti kāranībhūtatvena kāmye adhikāri viśeṣaṇa jñāpayati yeneti | anuṣṭhāna mātreṇa mahābhogo bhavati | nanu bhogasya mokṣapratibandhakatvāt mokṣārthina statrāpravṛttiḥ syādityaśaṅkya āha bhogena mokṣamāpnuyāditi | ata eva vidyāyāḥ sarvotkṛṣṭatvaṃ sūcitam | tathā ca vīratantre
yatrāsti bhogo naca tatra mokṣaḥ yatrāsti mokṣo na ca tatra bhogaḥ | śivā padāmbhojayugārcitānāṃ bhogaśca mokṣaśca karastha eva || nanu amuṣyahetornijasiddhaye cetyādi nindārtha vāha śravanāt mahāprakāśaḥ kathaṃ kriyate ityāha tevasnehāditi |) yadyapi krūratvāt loke duṣṭaloke yat vaktuṃ nocitaṃ tathāpi bhavadbhaktu'drekāt prakāśyate | tathāca śiṣyāyabhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya prakāśayediti | praśnānantaraṃ mantramuddharati | śivaḥ haḥ(,) śikhī rephaḥ(,) sitabhānuccandrakhaṇḍaḥ(,) pañcamānta'svaraḥ ūḥ te dru(/)miti siddham | apūrvamutkṛṣṭaṃ athavā anādipariprāptam | athavā nāsti pūrvo mahaduta kṛṣṭaṃ yasmāditi | ugraprabhāyāḥ navadurgāyāḥ | khamanīnāṃ sūryāṇāṃ maṇḍalamadhye dhyātvā duradṛṣṭaṃ kṣapayati nāśayatītyarthaḥ | vādiśreṣṭaśca bhavati ||(1)|| vairisamūhaṃ jayati vādisamūhaṃ vivāde laghusvarūpaṃ karoti | ramaṇīnāṃ cittaṃ harati | dīrghajīvī bhavati | adṛṣṭamapi sukāvyaṃ chāyārahitañca karoti | madhumati rapi heyā | animādayaśca ke tāvad varākā iti prakaṭārthaḥ | guptārthastu ṣaṭcakraṃ bhittvā sarvorddhe khamaṇīnāṃ candrasūryāṇāṃ madhye ākāśapadme (the) kuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā etadvījarūpāṃ tāṃ candrāmṛtana snāpayitvā īśvareṇa śivena saha kriḍāṃ kārāyitvā mūlādhāramānīya gurumukhaprathita tattat karmaṇā (vartmanā) uktaphalena phalī bhavati | prakārāntareṇa yonivando'pi kathitaḥ ||(2)|| nanu yonirandhāsamarthastadā kiṃ syādityāha kulayuvatīti | kulayuvatīṣu yonau kuṇḍalinīyonau suṣumnāmadhyabhāge gāndhārīmadhye nānāvidha doṣa jālagrasta mantravarṇān vicintya gurukulānāṃ kauṭilyaśūṇyatāṃ jñātvā manupuṭita paṭīyān bījadvayamadhye mantrasya pratyekavarṇaṃ vicintya śāntacetā gurubhaktaḥ sādhayet | evaṃ kṛte duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyatīti guptārthaḥ | atiguptārthastu kulayuvati kulāgāre bījadvayaṃ vilikhya tato mantrasyādivarṇaṃ tato bījadvitayaṃ evaṃ krameṇa sarvavarṇān vilikhya saṃskāraḥ kāryaḥ | tadā sidhyati | gururyadi durātmā svayamapi ca tathā cenna tathā | ata eva gurorvāhyāntara ceṣṭāṃ jñātvā tathā kāryam | tathā ca antaḥ nālokya kulajaṃ vartma devatārādhanaṃ tathā | yaḥ karoti na tat tasya bandhyāyāḥ saṅgamo yathā || vidhijñaḥ vakṣyamāna vidhijña ityarthaḥ | yadi śuddhavartmā tadā purovidhirna cedaparā sā agre vaktavyā | nanu vidhau paradārādyāsaṅga nindārtha vādaśravanāt valavadāniṣṭā nubandhitve kuto vidhipravṛttiḥ iti cenna tathaiva śrutibodhanāt | nanū śyenenābhicaraṇ yajedityatra śruti bodhanāt kuto vijñāne pravṛttiriti cet tatra tatvena nindārthavādaśravanādityavehi atra tu sāmānyato niṣedhaḥ viśeṣaśrutyā bādhate | tathā ca dhiyāmīt sargikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ viśeṣenopapadyate | yathā mā hiṃ syāt sarva bhūtāṇi | viśeṣastu daikṣaṃ paśumālabhediti tadvārakam | anyathā aśvamedhādāvapi ananuṣṭhāna prasaṅgaḥ | kecittu yadi śyenavadhe balavadveṣāviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ janyate tadā śyenayāgaḥ kāryaḥ | tadvadihāpi | yadyanekavartmanā kartumicchati tadā tadasaṃsargaḥ kāryaḥ | anyathā guruvartmānveṣanenāsya sarvatra śuddhavartmatvāt | tat paśupraṇapitam | tatra tatvena nindārthavāda śravaṇāt etaduktam | atra tu na tathā | anyathā vihita navavadhādāvananuṣṭhāna prasaṅgaḥ | yattu guruvartmānveṣanaṃ tattukulācāra jñāpanārtham | vacanena tathā bodhanāt | yathā keṣāñcit ṣaṣṭhadivase sutikā pūjā deṣāñcidekaviṃśatidivase ityatra doṣābhāve kulakramalaṅghanabhiyā tadviparyayaḥ tadvat atrāpīti vicārya maheśahṛdayākūtavyākhyāna prarohaṃ nānyathā vaktavyaḥ śāktaśaiva vaiṣṇavacaraneḥ ||(3)|| nanū tadvidhānaṃ kiṃ bhavedityāha kūlapathetyādi | he mātaḥ tatvena kūlathaṃ jñātvā amitāyāṃ sarvotkṛṣṭvatvāt svabhūmau sahasrāre tīrthatoyairamṛta vṛṣṭibhiḥ yaṃ starpanaṃ karoti tuṣṭimāracayati mānasagandhādibhiravyarcya yuvatī rūpaṃ dhyātvā yātāyāta kramena kulakuṇḍalinīṃ vakṣyamāna krameṇa cakraṃ nirmāya gandhādibhiḥ saṃpūjya devadravyena yadi tarpanaṃ karoti tadā vakṣyamāna phalabhāg bhavati | devadravyantu kubjikāyāṃ
